WITH school_sat AS (
  SELECT
    cds,
    1.0 * NumGE1500 / NumTstTakr AS excellence_rate
  FROM satscores
  WHERE rtype = 'S'
    AND NumTstTakr > 0
)
SELECT MAX(f."Percent (%) Eligible Free (Ages 5-17)") AS highest_ages_5_17_free_meal_eligibility_rate
FROM frpm AS f
JOIN school_sat AS s
  ON f.CDSCode = s.cds
WHERE s.excellence_rate > 0.3
  AND f."Percent (%) Eligible Free (Ages 5-17)" IS NOT NULL;

SELECT s.School, f."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (Ages 5-17)" AS percent_eligible_frpm_ages_5_17
FROM schools AS s
JOIN frpm AS f ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.County = 'Los Angeles'
  AND s.GSserved = 'K-9'
ORDER BY s.School;

SELECT f."Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)", f."District Code"
FROM schools AS s
JOIN frpm AS f ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.AdmFName1 = 'Alusine'
   OR s.AdmFName2 = 'Alusine'
   OR s.AdmFName3 = 'Alusine'
LIMIT 1000;

WITH candidates AS (
  SELECT
    s.CDSCode,
    s.NCESSchool,
    f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)" AS enrollment
  FROM schools AS s
  JOIN frpm AS f ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
  WHERE s.CDSCode IN ('1751010130583', '1612910137588', '1611760134270')
)
SELECT NCESSchool
FROM candidates
WHERE enrollment = (SELECT MAX(enrollment) FROM candidates);

WITH eligible_schools AS (
    SELECT CDSCode
    FROM schools
    WHERE CAST(CharterNum AS INTEGER) = 756
      AND MailCity = 'San Diego'
),
school_test_takers AS (
    SELECT e.CDSCode,
           COALESCE(MAX(s.NumTstTakr), 0) AS test_takers
    FROM eligible_schools AS e
    LEFT JOIN satscores AS s
        ON s.cds = e.CDSCode
    GROUP BY e.CDSCode
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(CAST(test_takers AS REAL)), 2) AS avg_sat_test_takers_per_school
FROM school_test_takers;

WITH eligible AS (
  SELECT
    s.School AS school_name,
    s.GSserved AS grade_span_served,
    CAST(
      substr(trim(s.GSserved), 1, instr(trim(s.GSserved) || '-', '-') - 1)
      AS INTEGER
    ) AS starting_grade
  FROM schools AS s
  WHERE s.NCESDist = '0613360'
    AND s.StatusType = 'Active'
    AND s.GSserved IS NOT NULL
    AND CAST(substr(trim(s.GSserved), instr(trim(s.GSserved), '-') + 1) AS INTEGER) >= 12
    AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM satscores AS ss
      WHERE ss.cds = s.CDSCode
        AND ss.NumTstTakr > 0
    )
)
SELECT school_name, grade_span_served
FROM eligible
WHERE starting_grade = (SELECT MIN(starting_grade) FROM eligible)
ORDER BY school_name;

WITH direct_schools AS (
    SELECT CDSCode, School, MailStreet, MailCity, MailState, MailZip
    FROM schools
    WHERE DOCType = 'State Board of Education'
      AND School IS NOT NULL
),
school_scores AS (
    SELECT d.School,
           d.MailStreet || ', ' || d.MailCity || ', ' || d.MailState || ' ' || d.MailZip
               AS FullMailingAddress,
           t.AvgScrRead AS AvgSATReadingScore
    FROM direct_schools AS d
    JOIN satscores AS t
      ON t.cds = d.CDSCode
    WHERE t.rtype = 'S'
      AND t.AvgScrRead IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT School, FullMailingAddress, AvgSATReadingScore
FROM school_scores
WHERE AvgSATReadingScore = (SELECT MAX(AvgSATReadingScore) FROM school_scores);

SELECT City
FROM schools
WHERE CDSCode = '01611920113902'
  AND County = 'Alameda'
  AND GSserved = '9-12';

WITH candidates AS (
  SELECT s.School, s.Phone, sat.NumGE1500
  FROM schools AS s
  JOIN satscores AS sat ON sat.cds = s.CDSCode
  WHERE s.Charter = 1
    AND s.DOCType = 'Statewide Benefit Charter'
    AND sat.rtype = 'S'
    AND sat.NumGE1500 IS NOT NULL
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT School, Phone,
         DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY NumGE1500 DESC) AS rank
  FROM candidates
)
SELECT School, Phone
FROM ranked
WHERE rank = 1;

SELECT sch.CDSCode, sch.School, sch.Charter, sch.FundingType, sch.GSoffered,
       s.AvgScrMath, s.NumTstTakr
FROM schools AS sch
LEFT JOIN satscores AS s ON s.cds = sch.CDSCode
WHERE sch.CDSCode = '1611190130609';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS count_ahead
FROM satscores AS target
JOIN satscores AS s ON s.cname = target.cname
WHERE target.cds = '7618040730051'
  AND target.rtype = 'S'
  AND s.rtype = 'S'
  AND s.NumTstTakr > target.NumTstTakr;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS qualifying_school_count
FROM schools AS s
JOIN satscores AS sat ON sat.cds = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.StatusType = 'Active'
  AND s.FundingType = 'Public'
  AND s.MailCity = 'San Francisco'
  AND s.DOCType IN (
    'Unified School District',
    'High School District',
    'Elementary School District',
    'County Office of Education (COE)'
  )
  AND sat.AvgScrRead + sat.AvgScrMath + sat.AvgScrWrite >= 1500;

WITH grades AS (
  SELECT CAST(TRIM(value) AS INTEGER) AS grade
  FROM schools, json_each('["' || replace(GSserved, '-', '","') || '"]')
  WHERE NCESDist = '0632640'
    AND GSserved IS NOT NULL
    AND TRIM(value) GLOB '[0-9]*'
)
SELECT MIN(grade) AS lowest_grade_level
FROM grades;

SELECT ROUND(AVG(COALESCE(f."FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)", 0)), 2) AS average_eligible_students_per_youth_authority_school
FROM schools s
LEFT JOIN frpm f
  ON f."CDSCode" = s."CDSCode"
 AND f."Academic Year" = '2014-2015'
WHERE s."DOC" = '34'
  AND s."District" LIKE '%Youth%';

WITH candidates AS (
  SELECT
    s.School AS school_name,
    s.AdmEmail1 AS administrator_email,
    sat.NumGE1500 AS count_1500
  FROM schools AS s
  JOIN satscores AS sat ON sat.cds = s.CDSCode
  WHERE s.DOCType = 'State Board of Education'
    AND s.SOCType IS NOT NULL
    AND sat.NumGE1500 IS NOT NULL
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    school_name,
    administrator_email,
    count_1500,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY count_1500 DESC) AS ranking
  FROM candidates
)
SELECT school_name, administrator_email, count_1500
FROM ranked
WHERE ranking = 1
ORDER BY school_name;

WITH middle_schools AS (
  SELECT
    "EdOpsName" AS school_type,
    "School" AS school_name,
    "Latitude" AS latitude
  FROM schools
  WHERE "State" = 'CA'
    AND "Latitude" IS NOT NULL
    AND (
      LOWER(COALESCE("EdOpsName", '')) LIKE '%middle%'
      OR LOWER(COALESCE("School", '')) LIKE '%middle%'
      OR LOWER(COALESCE("EdOpsName", '')) LIKE '%junior high%'
      OR LOWER(COALESCE("School", '')) LIKE '%junior high%'
    )
)
SELECT school_type, school_name, latitude
FROM middle_schools
WHERE latitude = (SELECT MAX(latitude) FROM middle_schools);

SELECT ROUND(AVG(COALESCE(s.NumTstTakr, 0)), 2) AS avg_sat_test_takers_per_school
FROM schools AS sch
LEFT JOIN satscores AS s ON s.cds = sch.CDSCode
WHERE sch.County = 'Los Angeles'
  AND sch.OpenDate >= '2007-01-01'
  AND sch.OpenDate < '2008-01-01'
  AND sch.DOCType IN (
    'Elementary School District',
    'High School District',
    'Unified School District'
  );

WITH candidates AS (
  SELECT
    f.CDSCode,
    f."School Name" AS school_name,
    f."Low Grade" AS earliest_grade_level,
    f."Enrollment (K-12)" AS enrollment_k12,
    CASE f."Low Grade"
      WHEN 'P' THEN 0
      WHEN 'K' THEN 1
      WHEN '1' THEN 2
    END AS grade_order
  FROM frpm AS f
  WHERE f."Academic Year" = '2014-2015'
    AND f."District Type" = 'State Special Schools'
    AND f."School Type" = 'State Special Schools'
    AND f."Low Grade" IN ('P', 'K', '1')
)
SELECT
  c.school_name,
  c.earliest_grade_level,
  c.enrollment_k12,
  COALESCE(s.NumTstTakr, 0) AS sat_test_takers
FROM candidates AS c
LEFT JOIN satscores AS s
  ON s.cds = c.CDSCode
ORDER BY c.grade_order DESC, c.enrollment_k12 DESC, c.school_name ASC
LIMIT 1;

WITH eligible AS (
  SELECT
    f.CDSCode,
    f."Charter Funding Type" AS funding_type,
    f."Enrollment (K-12)" AS enrollment,
    f."FRPM Count (K-12)" AS frpm_students,
    s.StatusType
  FROM frpm AS f
  JOIN schools AS s ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
  WHERE f."Academic Year" = (SELECT MAX("Academic Year") FROM frpm)
    AND f."Charter School (Y/N)" = 1
    AND f."Charter Funding Type" IN ('Directly funded', 'Locally funded')
    AND s.DOCType = 'County Office of Education (COE)'
)
SELECT
  funding_type,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN StatusType = 'Active' THEN CDSCode END) AS currently_operating_schools,
  SUM(CASE WHEN StatusType = 'Active' THEN enrollment ELSE 0 END) AS total_k12_enrollment,
  SUM(CASE WHEN StatusType = 'Active' THEN frpm_students ELSE 0 END) AS total_frpm_eligible_k12_students
FROM eligible
GROUP BY funding_type
ORDER BY CASE funding_type
  WHEN 'Directly funded' THEN 1
  WHEN 'Locally funded' THEN 2
END;

WITH closed_scores AS (
  SELECT
    sc.School AS school_name,
    sc.District AS district,
    sc.County AS county,
    sat.AvgScrWrite AS avg_sat_writing
  FROM schools AS sc
  JOIN satscores AS sat
    ON sat.cds = sc.CDSCode
  WHERE sc.StatusType = 'Closed'
    AND sat.AvgScrWrite IS NOT NULL
),
distinct_scores AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT avg_sat_writing
  FROM closed_scores
),
runner_up AS (
  SELECT MAX(avg_sat_writing) AS avg_sat_writing
  FROM distinct_scores
  WHERE avg_sat_writing < (
    SELECT MAX(avg_sat_writing)
    FROM distinct_scores
  )
)
SELECT school_name, district, county, avg_sat_writing
FROM closed_scores
WHERE avg_sat_writing = (SELECT avg_sat_writing FROM runner_up)
ORDER BY school_name;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS schools_with_zero_sat_takers
FROM schools AS s
LEFT JOIN satscores AS sat
  ON sat.cds = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.StatusType = 'Active'
  AND s.State = 'CA'
  AND s.EILName = 'High School'
  AND s.DOCType = 'Public'
  AND (sat.cds IS NULL OR sat.NumTstTakr = 0);

WITH monthly AS (
  SELECT strftime('%m', OpenDate) AS month, COUNT(*) AS openings
  FROM schools
  WHERE County = 'San Diego'
    AND DOCType = 'District'
    AND OpenDate >= '1980-01-01'
    AND OpenDate < '1981-01-01'
  GROUP BY strftime('%m', OpenDate)
)
SELECT CAST(COALESCE(SUM(openings), 0) AS REAL) / 12 AS average_schools_per_month
FROM monthly;

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN s.Virtual IN ('P', 'F') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 1) AS percentage
FROM satscores AS sat
JOIN schools AS s ON sat.cds = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.State = 'CA'
  AND sat.AvgScrMath > 400
  AND s.Virtual IN ('P', 'F', 'N');

WITH eligible AS (
  SELECT
    f."CDSCode",
    f."School Name" AS school_name,
    f."Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)" AS free_rate,
    s.Charter,
    s.GSserved,
    sat.AvgScrRead,
    sat.AvgScrMath,
    sat.AvgScrWrite
  FROM frpm AS f
  JOIN schools AS s ON s.CDSCode = f."CDSCode"
  LEFT JOIN satscores AS sat ON sat.cds = f."CDSCode"
  WHERE f."County Name" = 'Alameda'
    AND s.County = 'Alameda'
    AND s.StatusType = 'Active'
    AND s.GSserved IS NOT NULL
    AND instr(s.GSserved, '12') > 0
    AND f."Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)" IS NOT NULL
    AND f."Academic Year" = (SELECT MAX("Academic Year") FROM frpm)
),
highest AS (
  SELECT MAX(free_rate) AS max_rate
  FROM eligible
)
SELECT
  e.school_name,
  printf('%.4f', e.free_rate) AS free_meal_rate,
  CASE
    WHEN e.Charter = 1 THEN 'Yes'
    WHEN e.Charter = 0 THEN 'No'
    ELSE 'Unknown'
  END AS charter_school,
  e.GSserved AS grades_served,
  CASE
    WHEN e.AvgScrRead IS NULL
      OR e.AvgScrMath IS NULL
      OR e.AvgScrWrite IS NULL THEN 'No SAT Data'
    WHEN e.AvgScrRead + e.AvgScrMath + e.AvgScrWrite < 1500 THEN 'Below Average'
    WHEN e.AvgScrRead + e.AvgScrMath + e.AvgScrWrite = 1500 THEN 'Average'
    ELSE 'Above Average'
  END AS sat_performance_level
FROM eligible AS e
JOIN highest AS h ON e.free_rate = h.max_rate
ORDER BY e.school_name;

WITH virtual_schools AS (
  SELECT CDSCode, County, School
  FROM schools
  WHERE Virtual = 'F'
),
county_counts AS (
  SELECT County, COUNT(*) AS virtual_school_count
  FROM virtual_schools
  GROUP BY County
),
ranked_counties AS (
  SELECT County,
         virtual_school_count,
         RANK() OVER (ORDER BY virtual_school_count DESC) AS county_rank
  FROM county_counts
),
school_scores AS (
  SELECT v.County, v.School, s.AvgScrRead
  FROM virtual_schools AS v
  LEFT JOIN satscores AS s ON v.CDSCode = s.cds
),
best_scores AS (
  SELECT County, MAX(AvgScrRead) AS highest_reading
  FROM school_scores
  GROUP BY County
)
SELECT r.County AS county_name,
       r.virtual_school_count,
       CASE
         WHEN b.highest_reading IS NULL THEN 'None'
         ELSE ss.School
       END AS school_name
FROM ranked_counties AS r
LEFT JOIN best_scores AS b ON r.County = b.County
LEFT JOIN school_scores AS ss
  ON r.County = ss.County
 AND ss.AvgScrRead = b.highest_reading
WHERE r.county_rank <= 5
ORDER BY r.virtual_school_count DESC, r.County, school_name;

SELECT f."School Name" AS school_name, s.Street AS street_address
FROM frpm AS f
JOIN schools AS s ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE f."School Name" IS NOT NULL
  AND TRIM(f."School Name") <> ''
  AND f."Enrollment (K-12)" > f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)" + 30
  AND CAST(REPLACE(f."High Grade", ' ', '') AS INTEGER) <= 8
  AND CAST(REPLACE(f."High Grade", ' ', '') AS INTEGER) >= 0
ORDER BY f."School Name";

SELECT s.School AS school_name, s.Street AS street_address
FROM frpm AS f
JOIN schools AS s ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE CAST(f."Enrollment (K-12)" AS REAL) - CAST(f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)" AS REAL) > 30
  AND CAST(f."Low Grade" AS INTEGER) >= 9
ORDER BY f.CDSCode ASC

WITH qualifying_schools AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        f."CDSCode",
        f."County Name"
    FROM frpm AS f
    JOIN satscores AS s
      ON s.cds = f."CDSCode"
    WHERE f."Academic Year" = '2014-2015'
      AND f."Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)" > 0.1
      AND s.NumGE1500 >= 1
)
SELECT
    "County Name" AS county_name,
    COUNT(*) AS qualifying_school_count
FROM qualifying_schools
GROUP BY "County Name"
ORDER BY qualifying_school_count DESC, county_name ASC;

WITH target AS (
  SELECT County
  FROM schools
  WHERE CDSCode = '1611430131177'
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    s.AdmFName1,
    s.AdmLName1,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      ORDER BY sat.NumGE1500 DESC, s.CDSCode ASC
    ) AS rn
  FROM schools AS s
  JOIN satscores AS sat
    ON sat.cds = s.CDSCode
  JOIN target AS t
    ON s.County = t.County
  WHERE sat.rtype = 'S'
    AND sat.NumGE1500 IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT AdmFName1, AdmLName1
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1;

SELECT sc.Street, sc.City, sc.Zip, sc.State
FROM satscores AS sat
JOIN schools AS sc ON sc.CDSCode = sat.cds
WHERE sat.NumTstTakr >= 700
  AND sat.NumGE1500 IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY CAST(sat.NumGE1500 AS REAL) / sat.NumTstTakr ASC, sat.cds ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT
  s.City,
  COUNT(DISTINCT s.CDSCode) AS magnet_schools_provision_2
FROM schools AS s
JOIN frpm AS f
  ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.Magnet = 1
  AND f."NSLP Provision Status" = 'Provision 2'
GROUP BY s.City
ORDER BY s.City;

SELECT
    f."School Name" AS school_name,
    s."Street" AS street_address,
    s."City" AS city,
    s."State" AS state,
    s."Zip" AS zip_code
FROM frpm AS f
JOIN schools AS s ON s."CDSCode" = f."CDSCode"
WHERE f."County Name" = 'Los Angeles'
  AND f."FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)" > 500
  AND s."StatusType" = 'Active'
  AND (
      f."School Type" LIKE '%High School%'
      OR f."School Type" LIKE '%Single School District%'
  )
  AND f."School Type" NOT LIKE '%Middle%'
  AND f."School Type" NOT LIKE '%Junior High%'
ORDER BY f."School Name";

WITH provision2_magnet AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    f.CDSCode,
    f."County Name" AS county_name
  FROM frpm AS f
  JOIN schools AS s ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
  WHERE f."NSLP Provision Status" = 'Provision 2'
    AND s.Magnet = 1
)
SELECT
  p.county_name,
  SUM(COALESCE(sa.NumTstTakr, 0)) AS total_sat_test_takers
FROM provision2_magnet AS p
LEFT JOIN satscores AS sa ON sa.cds = p.CDSCode
GROUP BY p.county_name
ORDER BY p.county_name;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.uuid) AS distinct_card_printings
FROM cards AS c
WHERE (
    c.power IS NULL
    OR TRIM(c.power) = ''
    OR c.power LIKE '%*%'
    OR c.power LIKE '%X%'
    OR c.power LIKE '%?%'
)
AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM rulings AS r
    WHERE r.uuid = c.uuid
      AND LOWER(r.text) LIKE '%triggered ability%'
);

WITH relevant_cards AS (
  SELECT uuid
  FROM cards
  WHERE power IS NULL OR trim(power) = '' OR power LIKE '%*%'
)
SELECT ROUND(
  100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN fd.uuid IS NOT NULL THEN rc.uuid END)
  / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT rc.uuid), 0),
  2
) AS french_translation_percentage
FROM relevant_cards AS rc
LEFT JOIN foreign_data AS fd
  ON fd.uuid = rc.uuid
 AND lower(fd.language) = 'french';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.scryfallOracleId) AS count
FROM cards c
WHERE c.isPromo = 1
  AND lower(c.types) LIKE '%creature%'
  AND lower(c.leadershipSkills) LIKE '%brawl%'
  AND lower(c.leadershipSkills) NOT LIKE '%"brawl": false%';

SELECT
  MAX(CAST(strftime('%Y', s.releaseDate) AS INTEGER))
  - MIN(CAST(strftime('%Y', s.releaseDate) AS INTEGER)) AS years_between
FROM cards c
JOIN sets s ON s.code = c.setCode
WHERE c.name = 'Tarmogoyf'
  AND c.frameVersion IS NOT NULL;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT scryfallOracleId) AS count
FROM cards
WHERE borderColor = 'black'
  AND CAST(power AS REAL) >= 10
  AND availability LIKE '%mtgo%';

WITH translation_counts AS (
  SELECT setCode, COUNT(DISTINCT translation) AS translation_count
  FROM set_translations
  GROUP BY setCode
),
eligible_sets AS (
  SELECT s.code
  FROM sets AS s
  LEFT JOIN translation_counts AS t ON t.setCode = s.code
  WHERE COALESCE(t.translation_count, 0) < 5
),
card_counts AS (
  SELECT setCode, COUNT(*) AS card_count
  FROM cards
  GROUP BY setCode
)
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(c.card_count, 0)), 0) AS total_cards
FROM eligible_sets AS e
LEFT JOIN card_counts AS c ON c.setCode = e.code;

WITH translated_sets AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT setCode
  FROM set_translations
  WHERE translation IS NOT NULL
    AND TRIM(translation) <> ''
),
card_counts AS (
  SELECT setCode, COUNT(*) AS card_count
  FROM cards
  GROUP BY setCode
)
SELECT
  s.type AS set_type,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ts.setCode IS NOT NULL THEN s.id END) AS translated_set_count,
  COALESCE(
    SUM(
      CASE
        WHEN ts.setCode IS NOT NULL THEN COALESCE(cc.card_count, 0)
        ELSE 0
      END
    ),
    0
  ) AS total_cards
FROM sets AS s
LEFT JOIN translated_sets AS ts
  ON ts.setCode = s.code
LEFT JOIN card_counts AS cc
  ON cc.setCode = s.code
GROUP BY s.type
ORDER BY s.type COLLATE NOCASE, s.type;

WITH target AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT uuid
  FROM cards
  WHERE name = 'Mishra''s Factory'
),
latest_date AS (
  SELECT MAX(r.date) AS date
  FROM rulings r
  JOIN target t ON t.uuid = r.uuid
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS ruling_count
FROM rulings r
JOIN target t ON t.uuid = r.uuid
JOIN latest_date d ON r.date = d.date;

WITH creature_cards AS (
  SELECT artist, COALESCE(scryfallOracleId, uuid) AS card_id
  FROM cards
  WHERE artist IS NOT NULL
    AND types LIKE '%Creature%'
),
artist_counts AS (
  SELECT artist, COUNT(DISTINCT card_id) AS creature_card_count
  FROM creature_cards
  GROUP BY artist
)
SELECT artist, creature_card_count
FROM artist_counts
WHERE creature_card_count = (
  SELECT MAX(creature_card_count)
  FROM artist_counts
)
ORDER BY artist;

WITH newest_frames AS (
    SELECT MAX(frameVersion) AS frameVersion
    FROM cards
    WHERE convertedManaCost = 0
)
SELECT c.frameVersion, COUNT(*) AS card_count
FROM cards AS c
JOIN newest_frames AS n ON c.frameVersion = n.frameVersion
GROUP BY c.frameVersion;

WITH tarmogoyf_printings AS (
  SELECT frameVersion
  FROM cards
  WHERE name = 'Tarmogoyf'
),
frame_counts AS (
  SELECT frameVersion, COUNT(*) AS printing_count
  FROM tarmogoyf_printings
  GROUP BY frameVersion
),
totals AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_printings
  FROM tarmogoyf_printings
),
newest AS (
  SELECT frameVersion
  FROM frame_counts
  ORDER BY CAST(frameVersion AS INTEGER) DESC
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
  newest.frameVersion AS latest_frame_version_year,
  ROUND(100.0 * frame_counts.printing_count / totals.total_printings, 2)
    AS percentage_of_all_printings
FROM newest
JOIN frame_counts USING (frameVersion)
CROSS JOIN totals;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.name) AS card_count
FROM cards AS c
JOIN legalities AS l ON l.uuid = c.uuid
WHERE c.manaCost = '{0}'
  AND l.format = 'commander'
  AND l.status = 'Legal';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS card_count
FROM cards
WHERE keywords LIKE '%Flying%'
  AND keywords LIKE '%Cycling%';

WITH first_printing AS (
    SELECT s.code, s.name
    FROM cards c
    JOIN sets s ON s.code = c.setCode
    WHERE c.name = 'Abyssal Horror'
      AND s.releaseDate = (
          SELECT MIN(s2.releaseDate)
          FROM cards c2
          JOIN sets s2 ON s2.code = c2.setCode
          WHERE c2.name = 'Abyssal Horror'
      )
    ORDER BY s.code
    LIMIT 1
),
latest_set AS (
    SELECT code, name
    FROM sets
    WHERE releaseDate = (SELECT MAX(releaseDate) FROM sets)
    ORDER BY code
    LIMIT 1
),
chosen AS (
    SELECT * FROM first_printing
    UNION
    SELECT * FROM latest_set
)
SELECT chosen.name AS set_name,
       ROUND(
           100.0 * SUM(
               CASE
                   WHEN c.manaCost IS NOT NULL
                    AND c.manaCost <> ''
                    AND c.convertedManaCost <= 3
                   THEN 1
                   ELSE 0
               END
           ) / COUNT(*),
           2
       ) AS percentage
FROM chosen
JOIN cards c ON c.setCode = chosen.code
GROUP BY chosen.code, chosen.name
ORDER BY chosen.code;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(scryfallOracleId, name)) AS cards_count
FROM cards
WHERE promoTypes IS NOT NULL
  AND (',' || replace(replace(replace(lower(promoTypes), '[', ''), ']', ''), '"', '') || ',')
      LIKE '%,release,%';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS count
FROM cards
WHERE borderColor = 'white'
  AND power IS NOT NULL
  AND CAST(power AS REAL) < 3;

WITH eligible AS (
  SELECT name, convertedManaCost
  FROM cards
  WHERE setCode = 'DKA'
    AND keywords LIKE '%Flash%'
),
max_cost AS (
  SELECT MAX(convertedManaCost) AS cost
  FROM eligible
)
SELECT name
FROM eligible
WHERE convertedManaCost = (SELECT cost FROM max_cost)
ORDER BY name;

SELECT s.name, s.keyruneCode, COUNT(DISTINCT st.language) AS translated_name_language_count
FROM sets AS s
LEFT JOIN set_translations AS st ON st.setCode = s.code
WHERE s.releaseDate >= '2020-01-01'
  AND s.releaseDate < '2021-01-01'
GROUP BY s.id, s.name, s.keyruneCode
ORDER BY s.releaseDate, s.name;

WITH qualifying_sets AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT s.code
  FROM sets AS s
  JOIN set_translations AS st
    ON st.setCode = s.code
  WHERE s.releaseDate >= '2017-01-01'
    AND s.releaseDate < '2018-01-01'
    AND st.translation IS NOT NULL
    AND TRIM(st.translation) <> ''
)
SELECT COUNT(c.uuid) AS total_cards
FROM qualifying_sets AS qs
JOIN cards AS c
  ON c.setCode = qs.code;

WITH qualifying AS (
  SELECT artist
  FROM cards
  WHERE borderColor = 'black'
    AND availability LIKE '%arena%'
    AND CAST(power AS REAL) >= 10
    AND artist IS NOT NULL
),
counts AS (
  SELECT artist, COUNT(*) AS card_count
  FROM qualifying
  GROUP BY artist
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT artist, card_count,
         RANK() OVER (ORDER BY card_count DESC) AS artist_rank
  FROM counts
)
SELECT artist, card_count
FROM ranked
WHERE artist_rank = 1
ORDER BY artist;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT name) AS count_cards
FROM cards
WHERE hasContentWarning = 1
  AND availability LIKE '%paper%'
  AND (availability NOT LIKE '%mtgo%' OR mtgoId IS NULL);

SELECT s.type AS expansion_type,
       COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
           WHEN st.language = 'Japanese' AND st.translation IS NOT NULL THEN s.id
       END) AS sets_with_japanese_name
FROM sets AS s
LEFT JOIN set_translations AS st
    ON st.setCode = s.code
GROUP BY s.type
ORDER BY s.type ASC;

WITH card_power AS (
  SELECT c.artist
  FROM cards c
  WHERE c.artist IS NOT NULL
    AND c.borderColor = 'black'
    AND c.availability LIKE '%arena%'
    AND c.availability NOT LIKE '%mtgo%'
    AND c.power GLOB '[0-9]*'
    AND CAST(c.power AS INTEGER) >= 5
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT artist) AS artist_count
FROM card_power;

WITH ancestor_sets AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT s.code, s.releaseDate
  FROM cards c
  JOIN sets s ON s.code = c.setCode
  WHERE c.name = 'Ancestor''s Chosen'
),
latest_sets AS (
  SELECT code
  FROM ancestor_sets
  WHERE releaseDate = (SELECT MAX(releaseDate) FROM ancestor_sets)
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS count
FROM cards c
JOIN latest_sets ls ON ls.code = c.setCode
WHERE c.types LIKE '%Creature%'
  AND CAST(c.power AS INTEGER) > CAST(c.toughness AS INTEGER);

SELECT c.frameVersion AS frame_year, COUNT(DISTINCT c.scryfallOracleId) AS card_count
FROM cards AS c
WHERE c.leadershipSkills IS NOT NULL
  AND c.leadershipSkills <> '[]'
  AND c.cardKingdomFoilId IS NOT NULL
  AND c.cardKingdomId IS NOT NULL
  AND c.frameVersion IS NOT NULL
  AND c.scryfallOracleId IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY c.frameVersion
ORDER BY CAST(c.frameVersion AS INTEGER) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_official_rulings
FROM rulings AS r
JOIN cards AS c ON c.uuid = r.uuid
WHERE c.name = 'Fireball';

WITH card_rulings AS (
  SELECT c.name, COUNT(r.id) AS ruling_count
  FROM cards AS c
  LEFT JOIN rulings AS r ON r.uuid = c.uuid
  WHERE c.originalType = 'Creature - Elf'
  GROUP BY c.name
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT name, ruling_count, MAX(ruling_count) OVER () AS max_count
  FROM card_rulings
)
SELECT name, ruling_count
FROM ranked
WHERE ruling_count = max_count
ORDER BY name;

WITH card_colors AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT c.id, c.uuid, c.colors AS color
  FROM cards c
  WHERE c.id BETWEEN 1 AND 20
),
color_formats AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT cc.color, l.format
  FROM card_colors cc
  JOIN legalities l ON l.uuid = cc.uuid
  WHERE l.status = 'Legal'
)
SELECT color, COUNT(DISTINCT format) AS legal_format_count
FROM color_formats
GROUP BY color
ORDER BY color;

WITH foil_frames AS (
  SELECT CAST(frameVersion AS INTEGER) AS frame_year, COUNT(*) AS card_count
  FROM cards
  WHERE artist = 'John Avon'
    AND hasFoil = 1
    AND frameVersion IS NOT NULL
    AND TRIM(frameVersion) <> ''
  GROUP BY CAST(frameVersion AS INTEGER)
),
latest AS (
  SELECT MAX(frame_year) AS frame_year
  FROM foil_frames
)
SELECT foil_frames.frame_year, foil_frames.card_count
FROM foil_frames
JOIN latest USING (frame_year);

SELECT COUNT(*) AS printing_count
FROM cards AS c
JOIN legalities AS l ON l.uuid = c.uuid
WHERE c.artist = 'Erica Yang'
  AND l.format = 'pauper'
  AND l.status = 'Legal'
  AND c.availability LIKE '%paper%'

SELECT name, cardKingdomFoilId, cardKingdomId
FROM cards
WHERE types LIKE '%Creature%'
  AND cardKingdomFoilId IS NOT NULL
  AND cardKingdomFoilId <> ''
  AND cardKingdomId IS NOT NULL
  AND cardKingdomId <> ''
ORDER BY CAST(cardKingdomFoilId AS INTEGER), name, CAST(cardKingdomId AS INTEGER)
LIMIT 3;

WITH qualifying_cards AS (
  SELECT c.uuid, c.type
  FROM cards AS c
  WHERE lower(c.watermark) = 'boros'
    AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM foreign_data AS f
      WHERE f.uuid = c.uuid
        AND f.language IS NOT NULL
        AND trim(f.language) <> ''
        AND lower(f.language) NOT IN ('english', 'en')
    )
),
type_counts AS (
  SELECT type, COUNT(*) AS card_count
  FROM qualifying_cards
  GROUP BY type
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT type, card_count, MAX(card_count) OVER () AS max_count
  FROM type_counts
)
SELECT type, card_count
FROM ranked
WHERE card_count = max_count
ORDER BY type;

WITH guild_cards AS (
  SELECT c.uuid, c.watermark
  FROM cards AS c
  WHERE lower(c.watermark) IN (
    'azorius', 'boros', 'dimir', 'golgari', 'gruul',
    'izzet', 'orzhov', 'rakdos', 'selesnya', 'simic'
  )
    AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM foreign_data AS fd
      WHERE fd.uuid = c.uuid
        AND lower(fd.language) <> 'english'
    )
),
counts AS (
  SELECT watermark AS guild, COUNT(DISTINCT uuid) AS card_count
  FROM guild_cards
  GROUP BY watermark
)
SELECT guild, card_count
FROM counts
WHERE card_count = (SELECT MAX(card_count) FROM counts)
ORDER BY guild;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(scryfallOracleId, name)) AS card_count
FROM cards
WHERE frameVersion >= '2015'
  AND COALESCE(text, originalText) IS NOT NULL
  AND TRIM(COALESCE(text, originalText)) <> ''

WITH newest_frame AS (
  SELECT MAX(CAST(frameVersion AS INTEGER)) AS year
  FROM cards
  WHERE frameVersion GLOB '[0-9]*'
)
SELECT DISTINCT name
FROM cards
WHERE isPromo = 1
  AND layout <> 'normal'
  AND CAST(frameVersion AS INTEGER) = (SELECT year FROM newest_frame)
ORDER BY name;

SELECT s.name AS set_name, s.releaseDate
FROM cards AS c
JOIN sets AS s ON s.code = c.setCode
WHERE c.name = 'Tarmogoyf'
  AND c.isReprint = 1
  AND CAST(substr(s.releaseDate, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) - CAST(c.frameVersion AS INTEGER) >= 10
ORDER BY s.releaseDate, s.name;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS printing_count
FROM (
  SELECT c.uuid
  FROM cards AS c
  JOIN foreign_data AS fd ON fd.uuid = c.uuid
  WHERE c.name = 'Counterspell'
    AND lower(fd.language) IN ('french', 'italian')
  GROUP BY c.uuid
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lower(fd.language)) = 2
);

WITH target AS (
  SELECT type
  FROM sets
  WHERE name = 'From the Vault: Lore'
),
qualifying AS (
  SELECT s.name, s.code, s.releaseDate
  FROM sets AS s
  JOIN target AS t ON s.type = t.type
  WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM set_translations AS st
    WHERE st.setCode = s.code
      AND st.translation IS NOT NULL
      AND TRIM(st.translation) <> ''
  )
)
SELECT name, releaseDate
FROM qualifying
ORDER BY releaseDate, name;

WITH aven AS (
  SELECT c.setCode, c.frameVersion
  FROM cards AS c
  WHERE c.name = 'Aven Mindcensor'
),
newest_frame AS (
  SELECT MAX(frameVersion) AS frameVersion
  FROM aven
),
candidate_sets AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT s.name, s.releaseDate
  FROM aven AS a
  JOIN newest_frame AS nf ON a.frameVersion = nf.frameVersion
  JOIN sets AS s ON s.code = a.setCode
)
SELECT name AS set_name, releaseDate
FROM candidate_sets
WHERE releaseDate = (SELECT MAX(releaseDate) FROM candidate_sets)
ORDER BY name;

SELECT s.code, s.releaseDate
FROM sets AS s
WHERE s.releaseDate >= '2020-01-01'
  AND s.releaseDate < '2021-01-01'
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM set_translations AS st
    WHERE st.setCode = s.code
      AND lower(st.language) IN ('es', 'spa', 'spanish', 'spanish (spain)')
      AND st.translation IS NOT NULL
      AND trim(st.translation) <> ''
  )
ORDER BY s.releaseDate, s.code;

SELECT SUM(convertedManaCost) AS total_converted_mana_cost
FROM cards
WHERE artist = 'Rob Alexander'
  AND originalReleaseDate >= '2013-01-01'
  AND originalReleaseDate < '2014-01-01'
  AND originalReleaseDate IS NOT NULL;

SELECT ROUND(AVG(language_count), 2)
FROM (
  SELECT s.id, COUNT(DISTINCT st.language) AS language_count
  FROM sets AS s
  LEFT JOIN set_translations AS st
    ON st.setCode = s.code
   AND st.translation IS NOT NULL
   AND TRIM(st.translation) <> ''
  WHERE s.releaseDate >= '2016-01-01'
    AND s.releaseDate < '2017-01-01'
  GROUP BY s.id
);

WITH qualifying_cards AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    f.name AS japanese_name,
    c.type AS english_type,
    c.uuid
  FROM cards AS c
  JOIN foreign_data AS f
    ON f.uuid = c.uuid
  WHERE lower(c.watermark) = 'boros'
    AND lower(f.language) = 'japanese'
),
rulings_by_uuid AS (
  SELECT uuid, COUNT(*) AS ruling_count
  FROM rulings
  GROUP BY uuid
)
SELECT
  q.japanese_name,
  q.english_type,
  SUM(COALESCE(r.ruling_count, 0)) AS total_official_rulings
FROM qualifying_cards AS q
LEFT JOIN rulings_by_uuid AS r
  ON r.uuid = q.uuid
GROUP BY q.japanese_name, q.english_type
ORDER BY q.japanese_name, q.english_type;

WITH translated_printings AS (
  SELECT st.language, fd.uuid
  FROM set_translations AS st
  JOIN cards AS c
    ON c.setCode = st.setCode
  JOIN foreign_data AS fd
    ON fd.uuid = c.uuid
   AND fd.language = st.language
  WHERE fd.flavorText IS NOT NULL
    AND TRIM(fd.flavorText) <> ''
  GROUP BY st.language, fd.uuid
),
counts AS (
  SELECT language, COUNT(*) AS printings_with_translated_flavor
  FROM translated_printings
  GROUP BY language
)
SELECT language, printings_with_translated_flavor
FROM counts
WHERE printings_with_translated_flavor = (
  SELECT MIN(printings_with_translated_flavor)
  FROM counts
)
ORDER BY language;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.uuid) AS total
FROM cards c
WHERE c.types LIKE '%Creature%'
  AND c.power GLOB '[0-9]*'
  AND CAST(c.power AS INTEGER) >= 10
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM sets s
    JOIN set_translations st ON st.setCode = s.code
    WHERE st.language = 'French'
      AND (
        s.code = c.setCode
        OR (',' || REPLACE(COALESCE(c.printings, ''), ' ', '') || ',')
           LIKE '%,' || s.code || ',%'
      )
  );

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_printings
FROM cards
WHERE CAST(power AS REAL) > 3
  AND CAST(power AS REAL) <= 10;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS printing_count
FROM cards AS c
JOIN sets AS s ON s.code = c.setCode
WHERE c.originalReleaseDate >= '2014-01-01'
  AND c.originalReleaseDate < '2015-01-01'
  AND s.mtgoCode IS NOT NULL
  AND TRIM(s.mtgoCode) <> '';

SELECT fd.language, COUNT(*) AS printings
FROM foreign_data AS fd
JOIN cards AS c ON c.uuid = fd.uuid
JOIN sets AS s ON s.code = c.setCode
WHERE s.isForeignOnly = 0
  AND fd.language IS NOT NULL
  AND fd.language NOT IN ('Ancient Greek', 'Latin', 'Sanskrit', 'Phyrexian')
GROUP BY fd.language
HAVING COUNT(*) = (
  SELECT MIN(printing_count)
  FROM (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS printing_count
    FROM foreign_data AS fd2
    JOIN cards AS c2 ON c2.uuid = fd2.uuid
    JOIN sets AS s2 ON s2.code = c2.setCode
    WHERE s2.isForeignOnly = 0
      AND fd2.language IS NOT NULL
      AND fd2.language NOT IN ('Ancient Greek', 'Latin', 'Sanskrit', 'Phyrexian')
    GROUP BY fd2.language
  )
)
ORDER BY fd.language;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.uuid) AS count
FROM cards AS c
JOIN sets AS s ON s.code = c.setCode
JOIN foreign_data AS fd ON fd.uuid = c.uuid
WHERE lower(s.name) = 'coldsnap'
  AND lower(fd.language) = 'italian'
  AND fd.text IS NOT NULL;

WITH commander_2020 AS (
  SELECT id, code, name
  FROM sets
  WHERE type = 'commander'
    AND releaseDate >= '2020-01-01'
    AND releaseDate <= '2020-12-31'
),
card_counts AS (
  SELECT s.id, s.code, s.name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.uuid) AS total_card_count
  FROM commander_2020 AS s
  LEFT JOIN cards AS c
    ON c.setCode = s.code
   AND c.isOnlineOnly = 0
  GROUP BY s.id, s.code, s.name
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT *, MAX(total_card_count) OVER () AS max_count
  FROM card_counts
)
SELECT
  id,
  name,
  total_card_count,
  (
    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT fd.language)
    FROM foreign_data AS fd
    JOIN cards AS c ON c.uuid = fd.uuid
    WHERE c.setCode = ranked.code
  ) AS official_language_count
FROM ranked
WHERE total_card_count = max_count
ORDER BY id;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT fd.language) AS foreign_language_count
FROM cards c
JOIN foreign_data fd ON fd.uuid = c.uuid
WHERE c.name = 'Swamp'
  AND fd.language IS NOT NULL
  AND LOWER(fd.language) NOT IN ('english', 'en')

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.uuid) AS card_count
FROM cards c
JOIN foreign_data f ON f.uuid = c.uuid
WHERE c.colors = '["B"]'
  AND c.types LIKE '%Artifact%'
  AND f.language IS NOT NULL
  AND LOWER(f.language) <> 'english'
  AND f.flavorText IS NOT NULL
  AND TRIM(f.flavorText) <> '';

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(u.Reputation), 0) AS combined_reputation
FROM users AS u
WHERE u.Location LIKE '%United Kingdom%'
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM posts AS p
    WHERE p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
  );

SELECT ROUND(AVG(u.Age), 2) AS average_age
FROM users AS u
WHERE EXISTS (
  SELECT 1
  FROM comments AS c
  WHERE c.UserId = u.Id
    AND c.Text LIKE '%http%'
);

WITH organizer AS (
  SELECT b.UserId, b.Date AS organizer_date
  FROM badges AS b
  JOIN users AS u ON u.Id = b.UserId
  WHERE b.Name = 'Organizer'
    AND u.Location LIKE '%Germany%'
),
prior_badges AS (
  SELECT o.UserId, o.organizer_date, COUNT(*) AS badge_count
  FROM organizer AS o
  JOIN badges AS b
    ON b.UserId = o.UserId
   AND b.Date < o.organizer_date
  GROUP BY o.UserId, o.organizer_date
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT UserId) AS count
FROM prior_badges
WHERE badge_count >= 5;

WITH first_posts AS (
  SELECT OwnerUserId, MIN(CreaionDate) AS first_post_date
  FROM posts
  WHERE OwnerUserId IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY OwnerUserId
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS user_count
FROM first_posts AS fp
JOIN users AS u ON u.Id = fp.OwnerUserId
WHERE fp.first_post_date >= '2010-01-01'
  AND fp.first_post_date < '2011-01-01'
  AND LOWER(TRIM(u.Location)) = 'india';

SELECT ROUND(AVG(u.Reputation)) AS average_reputation
FROM posts AS p
JOIN users AS u ON u.Id = p.OwnerUserId
WHERE p.Score < 20
  AND p.Tags LIKE '%<r>%'
LIMIT 1;

WITH posts_2012 AS (
  SELECT p.Id, p.Score, p.LastEditorUserId
  FROM posts AS p
  WHERE p.CreaionDate >= '2012-01-01'
    AND p.CreaionDate < '2013-01-01'
),
germany_editors AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT u.Id, u.Reputation
  FROM posts_2012 AS p
  JOIN users AS u ON u.Id = p.LastEditorUserId
  WHERE u.Location LIKE '%Germany%'
)
SELECT
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN u.Id IS NOT NULL THEN p.Score ELSE 0 END), 0)
    AS germany_last_editor_posts_total_score,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN u.Id IS NULL THEN p.Score ELSE 0 END), 0)
    AS other_posts_total_score,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM germany_editors)
    AS germany_last_editor_user_count,
  (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(Reputation), 0) FROM germany_editors)
    AS germany_editors_combined_reputation
FROM posts_2012 AS p
LEFT JOIN users AS u
  ON u.Id = p.LastEditorUserId
 AND u.Location LIKE '%Germany%';

SELECT SUM(u.Reputation) AS combined_reputation
FROM posts AS p
JOIN users AS u ON u.Id = p.OwnerUserId
WHERE p.Tags LIKE '%<r>%'
  AND p.LasActivityDate >= '2014-08-27'
  AND p.LasActivityDate < '2014-08-28';

SELECT SUM(linking.Score) AS total_score
FROM postLinks AS l
JOIN posts AS target ON target.Id = l.RelatedPostId
JOIN posts AS linking ON linking.Id = l.PostId
WHERE target.Title = 'A Probability distribution value exceeding 1 is OK?'
  AND linking.Tags LIKE '%<r>%';

WITH badge_totals AS (
  SELECT u.Id, u.DisplayName, COUNT(b.Id) AS badge_total
  FROM users AS u
  JOIN badges AS b ON b.UserId = u.Id
  WHERE u.Location LIKE '%Germany%'
  GROUP BY u.Id, u.DisplayName
),
ranked_totals AS (
  SELECT badge_total,
         DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY badge_total DESC) AS total_rank
  FROM badge_totals
)
SELECT bt.DisplayName, bt.badge_total
FROM badge_totals AS bt
WHERE bt.badge_total = (
  SELECT MAX(badge_total)
  FROM ranked_totals
  WHERE total_rank = 2
)
ORDER BY bt.DisplayName;

WITH california_users AS (
  SELECT Id, DisplayName, Views, Reputation
  FROM users
  WHERE Location LIKE '%California%'
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    Id,
    DisplayName,
    Views,
    Reputation,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY Views DESC) AS view_rank
  FROM california_users
)
SELECT
  Id AS user_id,
  DisplayName AS display_name,
  Views AS profile_view_count,
  Reputation AS reputation
FROM ranked
WHERE view_rank = 1
ORDER BY Id;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT u.Id) AS user_count
FROM users AS u
JOIN badges AS b ON b.UserId = u.Id
WHERE u.Location LIKE '%India%'
  AND b.Name = 'Yearling'
  AND b.Date < '2014-01-01';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT u.DisplayName) AS different_display_names
FROM users AS u
JOIN badges AS b ON b.UserId = u.Id
WHERE b.Name = 'Supporter'
  AND u.Age BETWEEN 19 AND 65;

WITH target_posts AS (
  SELECT Id, Title
  FROM posts
  WHERE Title LIKE '%principal component scores%'
),
related_counts AS (
  SELECT t.Id, t.Title, COUNT(pl.Id) AS related_post_count
  FROM target_posts AS t
  LEFT JOIN postLinks AS pl ON pl.PostId = t.Id
  GROUP BY t.Id, t.Title
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    Id,
    Title,
    related_post_count,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY related_post_count DESC) AS rank_num
  FROM related_counts
)
SELECT Title, related_post_count
FROM ranked
WHERE rank_num = 1
ORDER BY Title;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(p.OwnerUserId, p.OwnerDisplayName)) AS user_count
FROM votes AS v
JOIN posts AS p ON p.Id = v.PostId
WHERE v.BountyAmount >= 30
  AND v.CreationDate >= '2010-01-01'
  AND v.CreationDate < '2011-01-01';

WITH active_users AS (
  SELECT OwnerUserId
  FROM posts
  WHERE OwnerUserId IS NOT NULL
    AND CreaionDate >= '2012-01-01'
    AND CreaionDate < '2013-01-01'
  GROUP BY OwnerUserId
  HAVING COUNT(*) > 10
)
SELECT
  ROUND(AVG(u.UpVotes), 2) AS avg_up_votes_cast,
  ROUND(AVG(u.Age), 2) AS avg_age
FROM active_users a
JOIN users u ON u.Id = a.OwnerUserId;

WITH months AS (
  SELECT 1 AS month_num UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3 UNION ALL SELECT 4 UNION ALL
  SELECT 5 UNION ALL SELECT 6 UNION ALL SELECT 7 UNION ALL SELECT 8 UNION ALL
  SELECT 9 UNION ALL SELECT 10 UNION ALL SELECT 11 UNION ALL SELECT 12
),
monthly AS (
  SELECT m.month_num,
         COUNT(DISTINCT pl.PostId) AS post_count
  FROM months AS m
  LEFT JOIN postLinks AS pl
    ON CAST(strftime('%m', pl.CreationDate) AS INTEGER) = m.month_num
   AND pl.CreationDate >= '2010-01-01'
   AND pl.CreationDate < '2011-01-01'
   AND EXISTS (
     SELECT 1
     FROM posts AS p
     WHERE p.Id = pl.PostId
       AND p.AnswerCount <= 2
   )
  GROUP BY m.month_num
)
SELECT month_num,
       post_count,
       ROUND(AVG(post_count * 1.0) OVER (), 2) AS average_monthly_posts
FROM monthly
ORDER BY month_num;

WITH qualifying AS (
  SELECT u.Reputation
  FROM posts AS p
  LEFT JOIN users AS u ON u.Id = p.OwnerUserId
  WHERE p.CreaionDate >= '2010-01-01'
    AND p.CreaionDate < '2011-01-01'
    AND p.Score > 5
)
SELECT ROUND(
  100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN Reputation IS NULL OR Reputation < 1000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
  / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0),
  2
) AS percentage_not_high_reputation
FROM qualifying;

WITH target AS (
  SELECT Id
  FROM posts
  WHERE Title = 'Why square the difference instead of taking the absolute value in standard deviation?'
),
edit_events AS (
  SELECT ph.UserId, ph.UserDisplayName
  FROM postHistory AS ph
  JOIN target AS t ON ph.PostId = t.Id
  WHERE ph.PostHistoryTypeId IN (4, 5)
),
counts AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(u.DisplayName, ee.UserDisplayName, '(unknown)') AS display_name,
    COUNT(*) AS edit_comment_count
  FROM edit_events AS ee
  LEFT JOIN users AS u ON ee.UserId = u.Id
  GROUP BY ee.UserId, COALESCE(u.DisplayName, ee.UserDisplayName, '(unknown)')
)
SELECT display_name, edit_comment_count
FROM counts
ORDER BY edit_comment_count DESC, display_name;

WITH consumption_2012 AS (
    SELECT
        CustomerID,
        SUM(Amount) AS total_consumption
    FROM transactions_1k
    WHERE Date >= '2012-01-01'
      AND Date < '2013-01-01'
    GROUP BY CustomerID
)
SELECT
    c.Segment AS client_segment,
    COUNT(*) AS customer_count
FROM consumption_2012 AS x
JOIN customers AS c
    ON c.CustomerID = x.CustomerID
WHERE x.total_consumption < 30000
GROUP BY c.Segment
ORDER BY c.Segment;

SELECT CAST(
    (julianday(MAX(t.Date || ' ' || t.Time)) - julianday(MIN(t.Date || ' ' || t.Time))) * 24 * 60
    AS INTEGER
) AS elapsed_whole_minutes
FROM transactions_1k AS t
JOIN gasstations AS g ON t.GasStationID = g.GasStationID
WHERE g.Country = 'CZE'
  AND t.Price > 1000;

WITH customer_2012 AS (
  SELECT
    c.CustomerID,
    c.Currency,
    SUM(t.Amount) AS consumption
  FROM customers c
  JOIN transactions_1k t ON t.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
  WHERE t.Date >= '2012-01-01'
    AND t.Date < '2013-01-01'
    AND c.Currency IN ('CZK', 'EUR')
  GROUP BY c.CustomerID, c.Currency
)
SELECT ROUND(
  AVG(CASE WHEN Currency = 'CZK' THEN consumption END)
  - AVG(CASE WHEN Currency = 'EUR' THEN consumption END)
) AS difference
FROM customer_2012;

WITH annual AS (
  SELECT CustomerID, SUM(Consumption) AS total_consumption
  FROM yearmonth
  WHERE Date >= '2013-01-01' AND Date < '2014-01-01'
  GROUP BY CustomerID
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS customer_count
FROM annual y
JOIN customers c ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
WHERE c.Segment = 'KAM'
  AND c.Currency = 'CZK'
  AND y.total_consumption > 1000000;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT t.CustomerID) AS sme_gas_customers
FROM transactions_1k AS t
JOIN customers AS c ON c.CustomerID = t.CustomerID
JOIN products AS p ON p.ProductID = t.ProductID
WHERE c.Segment = 'SME'
  AND t.Date >= '2013-02-01'
  AND t.Date < '2013-03-01'
  AND LOWER(p.Description) LIKE '%gas%';

SELECT ROUND(AVG(p.height), 2) AS average_height_cm
FROM Match AS m
JOIN Player AS p ON p.player_api_id = m.home_player_3
WHERE p.height > 180;

WITH eligible AS (

    p.player_api_id,

  FROM Player AS p
  JOIN Player_Attributes AS pa
    ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
  WHERE date(p.birthday) >= date('1991-01-01')
    AND pa.defensive_work_rate IS NOT NULL
    AND LOWER(pa.defensive_work_rate) <> 'null'
  GROUP BY p.player_api_id
)
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(ever_high) / COUNT(*), 2) AS share_high_percentage
FROM eligible;

WITH ranked_attributes AS (
  SELECT
    player_api_id,
    defensive_work_rate,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY player_api_id
      ORDER BY date DESC, id DESC
    ) AS rn
  FROM Player_Attributes
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(p.height), 2) AS average_height_cm
FROM Player AS p
JOIN ranked_attributes AS r
  ON r.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
WHERE r.rn = 1
  AND r.defensive_work_rate IS NOT NULL
  AND LOWER(TRIM(r.defensive_work_rate)) <> 'medium';

WITH risky_teams AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT team_api_id
  FROM Team_Attributes
  WHERE chanceCreationPassingClass = 'Risky'
),
repeated_names AS (
  SELECT t.team_short_name
  FROM Team AS t
  JOIN risky_teams AS rt ON rt.team_api_id = t.team_api_id
  GROUP BY t.team_short_name
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT t.team_api_id) > 1
),
attrs_on_date AS (
  SELECT
    team_api_id,
    chanceCreationPassing,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY team_api_id
      ORDER BY date DESC, id DESC
    ) AS rn
  FROM Team_Attributes
  WHERE date <= '2014-09-19'
)
SELECT
  t.team_short_name AS short_name,
  COUNT(DISTINCT t.team_api_id) AS club_count,
  ROUND(AVG(a.chanceCreationPassing), 1) AS avg_chance_creation_passing_risk
FROM repeated_names AS r
JOIN Team AS t ON t.team_short_name = r.team_short_name
JOIN risky_teams AS rt ON rt.team_api_id = t.team_api_id

  ON a.team_api_id = t.team_api_id
 AND a.rn = 1
GROUP BY t.team_short_name
ORDER BY avg_chance_creation_passing_risk DESC, short_name ASC;

WITH ranked AS (

),
current_medium AS (

SELECT ROUND(AVG(height), 2) AS average_height_cm

WITH left_footed AS (

WITH home_wins AS (

SELECT

SELECT s.season,

  ON i.season = s.season AND i.player_api_id IS NOT NULL
LEFT JOIN Player p
  ON p.player_api_id = i.player_api_id
GROUP BY s.season
ORDER BY s.season;

WITH ranked_ratings AS (
  SELECT
    pa.player_api_id,
    pa.volleys,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY pa.player_api_id
      ORDER BY pa.date DESC, pa.id DESC
    ) AS rn
  FROM Player_Attributes AS pa
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS player_count
FROM Player AS p
JOIN ranked_ratings AS r
  ON r.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
WHERE r.rn = 1
  AND p.height > 180
  AND r.volleys > 70;

WITH player_totals AS (
  SELECT home_player_3 AS player_id, SUM(home_team_goal) AS total_home_goals
  FROM Match
  WHERE home_player_3 IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY home_player_3
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(total_home_goals), 2) AS average_total_home_goals
FROM player_totals;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT player_api_id) AS player_count
FROM Player_Attributes
WHERE date <= '2015-01-01'
  AND preferred_foot = 'left'
  AND LOWER(attacking_work_rate) IN ('low', 'medium');

WITH ranked AS (
  SELECT
    player_api_id,
    preferred_foot,
    attacking_work_rate,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY player_api_id
      ORDER BY date DESC, id DESC
    ) AS rn
  FROM Player_Attributes
),
current_left_footed AS (
  SELECT attacking_work_rate
  FROM ranked
  WHERE rn = 1
    AND preferred_foot = 'left'
    AND attacking_work_rate IS NOT NULL
    AND TRIM(attacking_work_rate) <> ''
)
SELECT ROUND(
  100.0 * SUM(
    CASE WHEN LOWER(TRIM(attacking_work_rate)) = 'low' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
  ) / COUNT(*),
  1
) AS percentage
FROM current_left_footed;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT player_api_id) AS player_count
FROM Player_Attributes
WHERE date >= '2007-02-22'
  AND date < '2007-08-31'
  AND jumping >= 80;

WITH target AS (
  SELECT team_api_id
  FROM Team
  WHERE team_long_name = 'KSV Cercle Brugge'
),
last_match AS (
  SELECT MAX(m.date) AS match_date
  FROM Match AS m
  JOIN target AS t
    ON m.home_team_api_id = t.team_api_id
    OR m.away_team_api_id = t.team_api_id
  WHERE m.season = '2012/2013'
)
SELECT ta.buildUpPlaySpeedClass
FROM Team_Attributes AS ta
JOIN target AS t ON ta.team_api_id = t.team_api_id
JOIN last_match AS lm ON ta.date <= lm.match_date
ORDER BY ta.date DESC
LIMIT 1;

WITH latest AS (
  SELECT player_api_id, MAX(date) AS date
  FROM Player_Attributes
  WHERE date <= '2013-07-12'
  GROUP BY player_api_id
),
ratings AS (
  SELECT a.player_api_id, a.overall_rating
  FROM latest l
  JOIN Player_Attributes a
    ON a.player_api_id = l.player_api_id
   AND a.date = l.date
  WHERE lower(a.defensive_work_rate) IN ('low', 'medium', 'high')
),
avg_rating AS (
  SELECT AVG(overall_rating) AS avg_overall
  FROM ratings
),
donovan AS (
  SELECT r.overall_rating
  FROM ratings r
  JOIN Player p ON p.player_api_id = r.player_api_id
  WHERE p.player_name = 'Landon Donovan'
)
SELECT ROUND(
  100.0 * (d.overall_rating - x.avg_overall) / x.avg_overall,
  2
) AS percentage_higher
FROM donovan d
CROSS JOIN avg_rating x;

SELECT
  d.district_id,
  d.A2 AS district,
  ROUND((d.A13 - d.A12) * 100.0 / d.A12, 2) AS unemployment_rate_pct_change
FROM district AS d
WHERE d.A12 IS NOT NULL
  AND d.A12 <> 0
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM account AS a
    JOIN loan AS l ON l.account_id = a.account_id
    WHERE a.district_id = d.district_id
      AND l.status IN ('A', 'C')
  )
ORDER BY d.district_id;

WITH first_month_accounts AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT district_id
  FROM account
  WHERE date >= '1993-01-01'
    AND date < '1993-02-01'
),
district_populations AS (
  SELECT d.A2 AS district, d.A4 AS population
  FROM district AS d
  JOIN first_month_accounts AS a ON a.district_id = d.district_id
)
SELECT district, population
FROM district_populations
WHERE population = (SELECT MAX(population) FROM district_populations);

SELECT COUNT(*) AS transaction_count
FROM trans t
JOIN account a ON a.account_id = t.account_id
JOIN disp d ON d.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN client c ON c.client_id = d.client_id
WHERE c.gender = 'M'
  AND CAST(strftime('%Y', c.birth_date) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 1974 AND 1976
  AND (t.k_symbol IS NULL OR TRIM(t.k_symbol) = '');

SELECT d.A3 AS region, SUM(l.amount) AS total_approved_amount
FROM loan AS l
JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = l.account_id
JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
WHERE date(l.date) <= date('1995-12-31')
  AND date(l.date, '+' || l.duration || ' months', '-1 day') >= date('1995-12-31')
GROUP BY d.A3
HAVING SUM(l.amount) = (
  SELECT MAX(region_total)
  FROM (
    SELECT SUM(l2.amount) AS region_total
    FROM loan AS l2
    JOIN account AS a2 ON a2.account_id = l2.account_id
    JOIN district AS d2 ON d2.district_id = a2.district_id
    WHERE date(l2.date) <= date('1995-12-31')
      AND date(l2.date, '+' || l2.duration || ' months', '-1 day') >= date('1995-12-31')
    GROUP BY d2.A3
  )
);

WITH qualifying_districts AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT d.district_id, d.A11 AS average_salary
    FROM district AS d
    JOIN account AS a ON a.district_id = d.district_id
    JOIN disp AS dp ON dp.account_id = a.account_id
    JOIN client AS c ON c.client_id = dp.client_id
    WHERE d.A3 = 'east Bohemia'
      AND CAST(strftime('%Y', c.birth_date) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 1980 AND 1989
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(average_salary), 2) AS average_of_district_average_salaries,
       COUNT(*) AS district_count
FROM qualifying_districts;

WITH eligible_clients AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT c.client_id, c.district_id
  FROM client AS c
  JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = c.district_id
  JOIN disp AS own_disp ON own_disp.client_id = c.client_id
  WHERE d.A3 = 'central Bohemia'
    AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM disp AS account_disp
      JOIN card AS ca ON ca.disp_id = account_disp.disp_id
      WHERE account_disp.account_id = own_disp.account_id
    )
),
district_averages AS (
  SELECT ec.district_id, AVG(d.A11) AS avg_salary
  FROM eligible_clients AS ec
  JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = ec.district_id
  GROUP BY ec.district_id
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(avg_salary), 2) AS average_of_district_average_salaries
FROM district_averages;

WITH account_loan_counts AS (
    SELECT a.account_id, COUNT(l.loan_id) AS loan_count
    FROM account AS a
    JOIN disp AS d ON d.account_id = a.account_id
    JOIN client AS c ON c.client_id = d.client_id
    LEFT JOIN loan AS l ON l.account_id = a.account_id
    WHERE c.birth_date < '1950-01-01'
    GROUP BY a.account_id
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(loan_count), 2) AS avg_loans_per_account
FROM account_loan_counts;

WITH cohort_accounts AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT d.account_id
  FROM disp AS d
  JOIN client AS c ON c.client_id = d.client_id
  WHERE c.gender = 'M'
    AND CAST(strftime('%Y', c.birth_date) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 1974 AND 1976
)
SELECT
  COUNT(CASE WHEN t.k_symbol = 'household' THEN 1 END) AS household_payment_count,
  COUNT(CASE
          WHEN t.k_symbol IS NOT NULL AND t.k_symbol <> 'household' THEN 1
        END) AS other_purpose_payment_count
FROM trans AS t
JOIN cohort_accounts AS ca ON ca.account_id = t.account_id
WHERE t.type = 'out'
  AND t.amount > 4000;

WITH account_owners AS (
    SELECT
        a.account_id,
        a.date AS opening_date,
        c.district_id AS home_district_id
    FROM account AS a
    JOIN district AS branch
        ON branch.district_id = a.district_id
    JOIN disp AS dp
        ON dp.account_id = a.account_id
       AND dp.type = 'OWNER'
    JOIN client AS c
        ON c.client_id = dp.client_id
    WHERE branch.A2 = 'Prachatice'
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM loan AS l
          WHERE l.account_id = a.account_id
      )
),
borrowing_accounts AS (
    SELECT
        ao.account_id,
        ao.opening_date,
        ao.home_district_id,
        SUM(l.amount) AS total_borrowed
    FROM account_owners AS ao
    JOIN loan AS l
        ON l.account_id = ao.account_id
    GROUP BY ao.account_id, ao.opening_date, ao.home_district_id
),
counterparty_counts AS (
    SELECT
        t.account_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT t.account) AS outside_counterparties
    FROM trans AS t
    WHERE t.bank IS NOT NULL
      AND t.account IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY t.account_id
)
SELECT
    b.account_id,
    b.opening_date,
    b.total_borrowed,
    COALESCE(cp.outside_counterparties, 0) AS outside_counterparties,
    d.A2 AS home_district,
    d.A4 AS district_population,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY d.A4 DESC) AS population_rank
FROM borrowing_accounts AS b
JOIN district AS d
    ON d.district_id = b.home_district_id
LEFT JOIN counterparty_counts AS cp
    ON cp.account_id = b.account_id
ORDER BY d.A4 DESC, b.account_id ASC;

WITH account_avg AS (
  SELECT account_id, AVG(balance) AS avg_balance
  FROM trans
  GROUP BY account_id
),
eligible_districts AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    c.gender,
    d.district_id,
    d.A4 AS inhabitants,
    d.A11 AS average_salary,
    d.A13 AS urban_ratio
  FROM card AS ca
  JOIN disp AS dp ON dp.disp_id = ca.disp_id
  JOIN client AS c ON c.client_id = dp.client_id
  JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = dp.account_id
  JOIN account_avg AS aa ON aa.account_id = a.account_id
  JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
  WHERE lower(ca.type) = 'gold'
    AND aa.avg_balance > 1000
    AND d.A4 > 100000
    AND lower(c.gender) IN ('female', 'male', 'f', 'm')
),
gender_rows AS (
  SELECT 'women' AS gender_order, 'Women' AS gender, district_id, inhabitants, average_salary, urban_ratio
  FROM eligible_districts
  WHERE lower(gender) IN ('female', 'f')
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'men' AS gender_order, 'Men' AS gender, district_id, inhabitants, average_salary, urban_ratio
  FROM eligible_districts
  WHERE lower(gender) IN ('male', 'm')
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT *,
         MAX(inhabitants) OVER (PARTITION BY gender) AS max_inhabitants
  FROM gender_rows
),
summaries AS (
  SELECT gender,
         gender_order,
         COUNT(*) AS district_count,
         ROUND(AVG(average_salary), 2) AS avg_salary,
         ROUND(AVG(urban_ratio), 2) AS avg_urban_ratio
  FROM gender_rows
  GROUP BY gender, gender_order
)
SELECT s.gender,
       s.district_count,
       r.district_id AS most_populous_district_id,
       r.inhabitants AS most_populous_district_inhabitants,
       s.avg_salary,
       s.avg_urban_ratio
FROM summaries AS s
JOIN ranked AS r
  ON r.gender = s.gender
 AND r.inhabitants = r.max_inhabitants
ORDER BY s.gender_order, r.district_id;

WITH eligible_accounts AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT a.account_id
  FROM account AS a
  JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
  JOIN disp AS dp ON dp.account_id = a.account_id
  JOIN card AS c ON c.disp_id = dp.disp_id
  WHERE d.A4 >= 250000
    AND c.type = 'gold'
),
pair_totals AS (
  SELECT
    t.bank,
    t.account,
    COUNT(*) AS outgoing_payments,
    SUM(t.amount) AS total_amount
  FROM trans AS t
  JOIN eligible_accounts AS ea ON ea.account_id = t.account_id
  WHERE t.type = 'VYDAJ'
    AND t.date >= '1998-01-01'
    AND t.date < '1999-01-01'
  GROUP BY t.bank, t.account
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_amount DESC) AS amount_rank
  FROM pair_totals
)
SELECT
  bank AS recipient_bank_code,
  account AS recipient_counter_account_number,
  outgoing_payments,
  total_amount
FROM ranked
WHERE amount_rank = 1
ORDER BY recipient_bank_code, recipient_counter_account_number;

WITH purposeful_outgoing AS (
  SELECT t.amount, t.k_symbol
  FROM trans AS t
  JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = t.account_id
  JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
  WHERE d.A2 = 'Pisek'
    AND t.type = 'VYDAJ'
    AND t.k_symbol IS NOT NULL
    AND TRIM(t.k_symbol) <> ''
)
SELECT ROUND(
  100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN k_symbol = 'SIPO' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) / SUM(amount),
  2
) AS percentage
FROM purposeful_outgoing;

WITH qualifying_districts AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT cl.district_id
    FROM client AS cl
    JOIN disp AS d
      ON d.client_id = cl.client_id
     AND d.type = 'OWNER'
    JOIN account AS a
      ON a.account_id = d.account_id
    WHERE cl.gender = 'F'
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM card AS ca
          WHERE ca.disp_id = d.disp_id
      )
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM loan AS l
          WHERE l.account_id = a.account_id
      )
),
district_data AS (
    SELECT qd.district_id,
           di.A3 AS region,
           di.A2 AS district_name,
           di.A8 AS inhabitants,
           di.A11 AS salary,
           di.A13 AS unemployment_1996
    FROM qualifying_districts AS qd
    JOIN district AS di
      ON di.district_id = qd.district_id
),
region_avgs AS (
    SELECT region,
           ROUND(AVG(salary), 2) AS avg_district_salary,
           ROUND(AVG(unemployment_1996), 2) AS avg_unemployment_1996
    FROM district_data
    GROUP BY region
),
ranked_districts AS (
    SELECT region,
           district_name,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               PARTITION BY region
               ORDER BY inhabitants DESC, district_name ASC
           ) AS rn
    FROM district_data
)
SELECT ra.region,
       ra.avg_district_salary,
       ra.avg_unemployment_1996,
       rd.district_name AS most_populous_district
FROM region_avgs AS ra
JOIN ranked_districts AS rd
  ON rd.region = ra.region
 AND rd.rn = 1
ORDER BY ra.region;

WITH district_crimes AS (
    SELECT
        d.district_id,
        d.A2 AS district_name,
        d.A9 AS inhabitants,
        COUNT(t.trans_id) AS crimes_1996
    FROM district AS d
    LEFT JOIN account AS a ON a.district_id = d.district_id
    LEFT JOIN trans AS t
        ON t.account_id = a.account_id
       AND t.date >= '1996-01-01'
       AND t.date < '1997-01-01'
       AND t.type = '借'
    WHERE d.A3 = 'central Bohemia'
    GROUP BY d.district_id, d.A2, d.A9
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            ORDER BY inhabitants DESC, district_name COLLATE NOCASE ASC
        ) AS rn
    FROM district_crimes
),
all_district_crimes AS (
    SELECT
        d.district_id,
        COUNT(t.trans_id) AS crimes_1996
    FROM district AS d
    LEFT JOIN account AS a ON a.district_id = d.district_id
    LEFT JOIN trans AS t
        ON t.account_id = a.account_id
       AND t.date >= '1996-01-01'
       AND t.date < '1997-01-01'
       AND t.type = '借'
    GROUP BY d.district_id
)
SELECT
    MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 1 THEN district_name END) AS district_1,
    MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 1 THEN crimes_1996 END) AS crimes_1996_1,
    MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 2 THEN district_name END) AS district_2,
    MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 2 THEN crimes_1996 END) AS crimes_1996_2,
    MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 3 THEN district_name END) AS district_3,
    MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 3 THEN crimes_1996 END) AS crimes_1996_3,
    ROUND(AVG(crimes_1996), 2) AS top_three_average,
    (SELECT ROUND(AVG(crimes_1996), 2) FROM all_district_crimes) AS country_average,
    ROUND(
        AVG(crimes_1996)
        - (SELECT AVG(crimes_1996) FROM all_district_crimes),
        2
    ) AS difference
FROM ranked
WHERE rn <= 3;

WITH holders AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ca.type, cl.district_id
  FROM card AS ca
  JOIN disp AS dp ON dp.disp_id = ca.disp_id
  JOIN client AS cl ON cl.client_id = dp.client_id
  WHERE lower(ca.type) IN ('gold', 'classic', 'junior')
),
districts AS (
  SELECT h.type, d.district_id, d.A2 AS home_district, d.A4 AS inhabitants
  FROM holders AS h
  JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = h.district_id
),
minimums AS (
  SELECT type, MIN(inhabitants) AS inhabitants
  FROM districts
  GROUP BY type
)
SELECT d.type AS card_type, d.home_district, d.inhabitants
FROM districts AS d
JOIN minimums AS m
  ON m.type = d.type
 AND m.inhabitants = d.inhabitants
ORDER BY CASE lower(d.type)
  WHEN 'gold' THEN 1
  WHEN 'classic' THEN 2
  WHEN 'junior' THEN 3
END, d.home_district;

WITH target_region AS (
  SELECT A3 AS region
  FROM district
  WHERE A2 = 'Litomerice'
),
opened AS (
  SELECT account_id, district_id
  FROM account
  WHERE date >= '1996-01-01'
    AND date < '1997-01-01'
),
ranked_trans AS (
  SELECT
    t.account_id,
    t.balance,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY t.account_id
      ORDER BY t.date DESC, t.trans_id DESC
    ) AS rn
  FROM trans t
  JOIN opened o ON o.account_id = t.account_id
  WHERE t.date < '1997-01-01'
),
account_balances AS (
  SELECT o.account_id, o.district_id, rt.balance
  FROM opened o
  JOIN ranked_trans rt
    ON rt.account_id = o.account_id
   AND rt.rn = 1
  JOIN district d ON d.district_id = o.district_id
  WHERE d.A3 = (SELECT region FROM target_region)
),
district_stats AS (
  SELECT
    d.A2 AS district_name,
    COUNT(*) AS accounts_opened,
    ROUND(AVG(ab.balance), 2) AS avg_balance,
    AVG(ab.balance) AS raw_avg
  FROM account_balances ab
  JOIN district d ON d.district_id = ab.district_id
  GROUP BY d.district_id, d.A2
),
summary AS (
  SELECT ROUND(AVG(balance), 2) AS region_avg_balance
  FROM account_balances
),
winner AS (
  SELECT district_name
  FROM district_stats
  ORDER BY raw_avg DESC, district_name ASC
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
  ds.district_name,
  ds.accounts_opened,
  ds.avg_balance,
  s.region_avg_balance,
  w.district_name AS highest_average_district
FROM district_stats ds
CROSS JOIN summary s
CROSS JOIN winner w
ORDER BY ds.district_name;

WITH
client_home AS (
    SELECT district_id
    FROM client
    WHERE client_id = 3541
),
accessible_accounts AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
           a.account_id,
           a.date AS opened_date,
           a.frequency,
           a.district_id
    FROM disp AS p
    JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = p.account_id
    WHERE p.client_id = 3541
),
transaction_stats AS (
    SELECT account_id,
           COUNT(*) AS transaction_count,
           SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'PRIJEM' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_income,
           SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'VYDAJ' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_expense
    FROM trans
    GROUP BY account_id
),
region_districts AS (
    SELECT district_id,
           A3 AS region_name,
           A2 AS district_name,
           A4 AS inhabitants
    FROM district
),
ranked_districts AS (
    SELECT district_id,
           region_name,
           RANK() OVER (
               PARTITION BY region_name
               ORDER BY inhabitants DESC
           ) AS population_rank
    FROM region_districts
),
region_home_client_counts AS (
    SELECT d.A3 AS region_name,
           COUNT(*) AS home_client_count
    FROM client AS c
    JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = c.district_id
    GROUP BY d.A3
),
region_population_leaders AS (
    SELECT region_name, district_name, inhabitants
    FROM (
        SELECT region_name,
               district_name,
               inhabitants,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                   PARTITION BY region_name
                   ORDER BY inhabitants DESC, district_name ASC
               ) AS rn
        FROM region_districts
    )
    WHERE rn = 1
)
SELECT aa.account_id,
       aa.opened_date,
       aa.frequency,
       d.A2 AS district_name,
       d.A3 AS region_name,
       CASE WHEN d.district_id = ch.district_id THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END
           AS is_client_home_district,
       d.A11 AS average_salary,
       COALESCE(l.status, 'none') AS loan_repayment_status,
       COALESCE(l.amount, 0) AS loan_amount,
       COALESCE(ts.transaction_count, 0) AS transaction_count,
       COALESCE(ts.total_income, 0) AS total_income,
       COALESCE(ts.total_expense, 0) AS total_expense,
       COALESCE(ts.total_income, 0) - COALESCE(ts.total_expense, 0)
           AS net_balance,
       COALESCE(hc.home_client_count, 0)
           AS clients_with_home_district_in_region,
       pl.district_name AS most_populous_district_name,
       pl.inhabitants AS most_populous_district_inhabitants,
       rd.population_rank AS account_district_population_rank
FROM accessible_accounts AS aa
JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = aa.district_id
CROSS JOIN client_home AS ch
LEFT JOIN loan AS l ON l.account_id = aa.account_id
LEFT JOIN transaction_stats AS ts ON ts.account_id = aa.account_id
LEFT JOIN ranked_districts AS rd ON rd.district_id = aa.district_id
LEFT JOIN region_home_client_counts AS hc ON hc.region_name = d.A3
LEFT JOIN region_population_leaders AS pl ON pl.region_name = d.A3
ORDER BY transaction_count DESC, aa.account_id ASC;

WITH account_year AS (
    SELECT
        a.account_id,
        a.district_id,
        strftime('%Y', a.date) AS opening_year
    FROM account AS a
    JOIN district AS d
      ON d.district_id = a.district_id
    WHERE d.A3 = 'central Bohemia'
      AND a.date >= '1996-01-01'
),
district_year AS (
    SELECT
        ay.opening_year,
        ay.district_id,
        COUNT(*) AS accounts_opened,
        SUM(COALESCE(l.amount, 0)) AS amount_lent
    FROM account_year AS ay
    LEFT JOIN loan AS l
      ON l.account_id = ay.account_id
    GROUP BY ay.opening_year, ay.district_id
)
SELECT
    opening_year,
    SUM(accounts_opened) AS accounts_opened,
    SUM(amount_lent) AS total_amount_lent,
    ROUND(AVG(1.0 * amount_lent / accounts_opened), 2)
        AS avg_district_amount_lent_per_account
FROM district_year
GROUP BY opening_year
ORDER BY opening_year;

WITH ranked_loans AS (
  SELECT
    l.loan_id,
    l.account_id,
    l.date AS approval_date,
    l.amount AS approved_amount,
    d.A2 AS district,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      ORDER BY l.amount DESC, l.date ASC, l.loan_id ASC
    ) AS loan_rank
  FROM loan AS l
  JOIN account AS a
    ON a.account_id = l.account_id
  JOIN district AS d
    ON d.district_id = a.district_id
  WHERE l.duration = 24
    AND a.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE'
),
loan_balances AS (
  SELECT
    rl.district,
    rl.approved_amount,
    rl.approval_date,
    (
      SELECT t.balance
      FROM trans AS t
      WHERE t.account_id = rl.account_id
        AND date(t.date) <= date(rl.approval_date)
      ORDER BY date(t.date) DESC, t.trans_id DESC
      LIMIT 1
    ) AS end_of_approval_day_balance,
    rl.loan_rank
  FROM ranked_loans AS rl
  WHERE rl.loan_rank <= 10
)
SELECT
  district,
  approved_amount,
  approval_date,
  end_of_approval_day_balance
FROM loan_balances
ORDER BY loan_rank;

WITH branch_counts AS (
  SELECT
    d.A2 AS branch_name,
    COUNT(t.trans_id) AS transaction_count
  FROM district d
  JOIN account a ON a.district_id = d.district_id
  JOIN trans t ON t.account_id = a.account_id
  WHERE d.A3 = 'north Moravia'
    AND t.date <= '1998-10-14'
    AND (t.k_symbol IS NULL OR TRIM(t.k_symbol) = '')
  GROUP BY d.district_id, d.A2
)
SELECT branch_name, transaction_count
FROM branch_counts
ORDER BY transaction_count DESC, branch_name ASC
LIMIT 3;

WITH applicant_account AS (
  SELECT account_id
  FROM loan
  WHERE loan_id = 98832
    AND date = '1996-01-03'
)
SELECT
  t.bank AS bank_code,
  t.account AS account_number,
  COUNT(*) AS outgoing_payment_count,
  SUM(t.amount) AS total_amount_paid
FROM trans AS t
JOIN applicant_account AS a ON a.account_id = t.account_id
WHERE t.type = 'VYDAJ'
  AND t.date < '1996-01-03'
GROUP BY t.bank, t.account
ORDER BY total_amount_paid DESC;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS account_count
FROM account AS a
JOIN loan AS l ON l.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE a.district_id = 1
  AND a.date <= '1995-12-31'
  AND l.date <= '1995-12-31'
  AND l.status NOT IN ('A', 'B');

SELECT
  (SELECT SUM(t.amount)
   FROM trans AS t
   JOIN disp AS d ON d.account_id = t.account_id
   WHERE d.client_id = 2823
     AND t.date >= '1998-01-01'
     AND t.date < '1999-01-01'
     AND t.type = 'PRIJEM'
     AND t.k_symbol = 'UROK')
  -
  (SELECT SUM(t.amount)
   FROM trans AS t
   JOIN disp AS d ON d.account_id = t.account_id
   WHERE d.client_id = 2823
     AND t.date >= '1998-01-01'
     AND t.date < '1999-01-01'
     AND t.type = 'VYDAJ'
     AND t.k_symbol = 'SANKC. UROK') AS net_interest_czk;

WITH female_loans AS (
    SELECT
        l.loan_id,
        l.account_id,
        l.amount,
        l.duration,
        l.payments,
        l.status,
        c.client_id,
        c.birth_date
    FROM loan AS l
    JOIN disp AS dp ON dp.account_id = l.account_id
    JOIN client AS c ON c.client_id = dp.client_id
    WHERE c.gender = 'F'
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY amount DESC) AS amount_rank
    FROM female_loans
),
account_transactions AS (
    SELECT
        account_id,
        COUNT(*) AS transaction_count,
        SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'credit' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_deposits
    FROM trans
    GROUP BY account_id
),
region_loans AS (
    SELECT
        d.A3 AS region,
        COUNT(*) AS loan_count
    FROM loan AS l
    JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = l.account_id
    JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
    GROUP BY d.A3
),
region_salary AS (
    SELECT
        A3 AS region,
        ROUND(AVG(A11), 2) AS avg_district_salary
    FROM district
    GROUP BY A3
)
SELECT
    r.client_id,
    r.loan_id,
    r.amount AS loan_amount,
    r.duration AS duration_months,
    ROUND(r.payments * r.duration, 2) AS total_payments,
    ROUND(r.payments * r.duration - r.amount, 2) AS interest_paid,
    r.status AS loan_status,
    branch.A2 AS branch_district,
    branch.A3 AS branch_region,
    COALESCE(at.transaction_count, 0) AS transaction_count,
    ROUND(COALESCE(at.total_deposits, 0), 2) AS total_deposits,
    CASE
        WHEN COALESCE(at.total_deposits, 0) > 2 * r.amount THEN 'High Income'
        WHEN COALESCE(at.total_deposits, 0) > r.amount THEN 'Medium Income'
        ELSE 'Low Income'
    END AS income_category,
    rl.loan_count AS region_loan_count,
    rs.avg_district_salary AS region_avg_of_district_salaries,
    CAST(strftime('%Y', '2026-10-09') AS INTEGER)
        - CAST(strftime('%Y', r.birth_date) AS INTEGER)
        - (strftime('%m-%d', '2026-10-09') < strftime('%m-%d', r.birth_date)) AS completed_age
FROM ranked AS r
JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = r.account_id
JOIN district AS branch ON branch.district_id = a.district_id
LEFT JOIN account_transactions AS at ON at.account_id = r.account_id
JOIN region_loans AS rl ON rl.region = branch.A3
JOIN region_salary AS rs ON rs.region = branch.A3
WHERE r.amount_rank <= 3
ORDER BY r.amount DESC, r.loan_id;

WITH gold_accounts AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT d.account_id
    FROM card AS c
    JOIN disp AS d ON d.disp_id = c.disp_id
    WHERE lower(c.type) = 'gold'
),
transaction_totals AS (
    SELECT
        account_id,
        SUM(CASE WHEN lower(type) = 'in' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_received,
        SUM(CASE WHEN lower(type) = 'out' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_withdrawn,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
            WHEN account IS NOT NULL AND account <> account_id THEN account
        END) AS external_counterparty_count
    FROM trans
    GROUP BY account_id
),
loan_totals AS (
    SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) AS loan_count
    FROM loan
    GROUP BY account_id
),
account_summary AS (
    SELECT
        ga.account_id,
        di.A2 AS district_name,
        di.A3 AS region,
        COALESCE(tt.total_received, 0) AS total_received,
        COALESCE(tt.total_withdrawn, 0) AS total_withdrawn,
        COALESCE(lt.loan_count, 0) AS loan_count,
        COALESCE(tt.external_counterparty_count, 0) AS external_counterparty_count
    FROM gold_accounts AS ga
    JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = ga.account_id
    JOIN district AS di ON di.district_id = a.district_id
    LEFT JOIN transaction_totals AS tt ON tt.account_id = ga.account_id
    LEFT JOIN loan_totals AS lt ON lt.account_id = ga.account_id
)
SELECT
    account_id,
    district_name,
    region,
    total_received,
    total_withdrawn,
    loan_count,
    external_counterparty_count,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY external_counterparty_count DESC) AS counterparty_rank
FROM account_summary
ORDER BY counterparty_rank, account_id;

WITH asof_accounts AS (
    SELECT a.account_id, a.date AS opened_date
    FROM account AS a
    JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
    WHERE d.A2 = 'Tabor'
      AND a.date <= '1996-12-31'
),
owner_profiles AS (
    SELECT
        aa.account_id,
        aa.opened_date,
        c.gender,
        CAST(strftime('%Y', '1996-12-31') AS INTEGER)
          - CAST(strftime('%Y', c.birth_date) AS INTEGER)
          - CASE
                WHEN strftime('%m-%d', c.birth_date) > '12-31' THEN 1
                ELSE 0
            END AS age_years
    FROM asof_accounts AS aa
    JOIN disp AS dp
      ON dp.account_id = aa.account_id
     AND dp.type = 'OWNER'
    JOIN client AS c ON c.client_id = dp.client_id
),
cards_asof AS (
    SELECT dp.account_id, COUNT(*) AS card_count
    FROM disp AS dp
    JOIN card AS ca ON ca.disp_id = dp.disp_id
    JOIN asof_accounts AS aa ON aa.account_id = dp.account_id
    WHERE ca.issued <= '1996-12-31'
    GROUP BY dp.account_id
),
loans_asof AS (
    SELECT
        l.account_id,
        COUNT(*) AS loan_count,
        CASE
            WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'B' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0
                THEN 'defaulted'
            WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN l.status IN ('C', 'D') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0
                THEN 'repaying'
            ELSE 'paid off'
        END AS loan_standing
    FROM loan AS l
    JOIN asof_accounts AS aa ON aa.account_id = l.account_id
    WHERE l.date <= '1996-12-31'
    GROUP BY l.account_id
),
activity_1997 AS (
    SELECT
        t.account_id,
        COUNT(*) AS transaction_count,
        SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS money_in,
        SUM(CASE WHEN t.type IN ('VYDAJ', 'VYBER') THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS money_out,
        MAX(t.balance) AS peak_balance
    FROM trans AS t
    JOIN asof_accounts AS aa ON aa.account_id = t.account_id
    WHERE t.date >= '1997-01-01'
      AND t.date < '1998-01-01'
    GROUP BY t.account_id
),
profiles AS (
    SELECT
        op.account_id,
        op.opened_date,
        op.gender,
        op.age_years,
        COALESCE(ca.card_count, 0) AS card_count,
        COALESCE(la.loan_count, 0) AS loan_count,
        COALESCE(la.loan_standing, 'no loan') AS loan_standing,
        COALESCE(ac.transaction_count, 0) AS transaction_count,
        COALESCE(ac.money_in, 0) AS money_in,
        COALESCE(ac.money_out, 0) AS money_out,
        COALESCE(ac.peak_balance, 0) AS peak_balance
    FROM owner_profiles AS op
    LEFT JOIN cards_asof AS ca ON ca.account_id = op.account_id
    LEFT JOIN loans_asof AS la ON la.account_id = op.account_id
    LEFT JOIN activity_1997 AS ac ON ac.account_id = op.account_id
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY peak_balance DESC) AS peak_balance_rank
    FROM profiles
)
SELECT
    account_id,
    opened_date,
    gender,
    age_years,
    card_count,
    loan_count,
    loan_standing,
    transaction_count,
    money_in,
    money_out,
    peak_balance,
    peak_balance_rank
FROM ranked
ORDER BY peak_balance_rank, account_id;

SELECT ROUND(AVG(d.A11), 2) AS average_salary
FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT a.district_id
    FROM client AS c
    JOIN disp AS dp ON dp.client_id = c.client_id
    JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = dp.account_id
    WHERE c.gender = 'F'
      AND c.birth_date < '1930-01-01'
) AS qualifying_districts
JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = qualifying_districts.district_id;

SELECT ROUND(AVG(d.A11), 2)
FROM client AS c
JOIN district AS d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
  AND c.birth_date < '1950-01-01';

SELECT ROUND(AVG(pit_stop_count), 2) AS avg_pit_stops_per_race
FROM (
  SELECT r.raceId, COUNT(p.raceId) AS pit_stop_count
  FROM races AS r
  LEFT JOIN pitStops AS p ON p.raceId = r.raceId
  WHERE r.year = 2017
    AND r.circuitId NOT IN (
      SELECT circuitId
      FROM races
      WHERE year = 2000
    )
  GROUP BY r.raceId
);

SELECT
    d.forename,
    d.surname,
    d.url AS wikipedia_page,
    d.dob AS date_of_birth,
    COUNT(CASE
        WHEN q.q3 IS NOT NULL
         AND q.q3 <> '\N'
         AND TRIM(q.q3) <> ''
        THEN 1
    END) AS q3_times
FROM drivers AS d
LEFT JOIN qualifying AS q
    ON q.driverId = d.driverId
WHERE d.nationality = 'German'
  AND d.dob >= '1971-01-01'
  AND d.dob < '1986-01-01'
GROUP BY d.driverId, d.forename, d.surname, d.url, d.dob
ORDER BY q3_times DESC, d.dob ASC;

WITH race AS (
  SELECT raceId
  FROM races
  WHERE year = 1995
    AND name = 'Japanese Grand Prix'
),
timed AS (
  SELECT
    q.driverId,
    q.q1,
    CAST(substr(q.q1, 1, instr(q.q1, ':') - 1) AS INTEGER) * 60000
      + CAST(substr(q.q1, instr(q.q1, ':') + 1, 2) AS INTEGER) * 1000
      + CAST(substr(q.q1, instr(q.q1, '.') + 1) AS INTEGER) AS q1_ms
  FROM qualifying AS q
  JOIN race AS r ON r.raceId = q.raceId
  WHERE q.q1 IS NOT NULL
    AND q.q1 <> ''
),
slowest AS (
  SELECT MAX(q1_ms) AS max_ms
  FROM timed
)
SELECT d.driverRef, d.nationality, d.dob, t.q1
FROM timed AS t
JOIN slowest AS s ON t.q1_ms = s.max_ms
JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = t.driverId
ORDER BY d.driverRef;

WITH q1_times AS (
  SELECT
    d.forename,
    d.surname,
    q.q1,
    CAST(substr(q.q1, 1, instr(q.q1, ':') - 1) AS INTEGER) * 60000
      + CAST(substr(q.q1, instr(q.q1, ':') + 1, 2) AS INTEGER) * 1000
      + CAST(substr(q.q1, instr(q.q1, '.') + 1) AS INTEGER) AS q1_ms
  FROM qualifying q
  JOIN races r ON r.raceId = q.raceId
  JOIN drivers d ON d.driverId = q.driverId
  WHERE r.year = 1995
    AND r.name = 'Japanese Grand Prix'
    AND q.q1 IS NOT NULL
    AND instr(q.q1, ':') > 0
)
SELECT forename, surname, q1 AS q1_time
FROM q1_times
WHERE q1_ms = (SELECT MIN(q1_ms) FROM q1_times)
ORDER BY surname, forename;

WITH target AS (
  SELECT q.raceId, q.position
  FROM qualifying q
  JOIN drivers d ON d.driverId = q.driverId
  JOIN races r ON r.raceId = q.raceId
  WHERE r.year = 2010
    AND d.forename = 'Lucas'
    AND d.surname = 'di Grassi'
    AND q.position IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS drivers_outqualified
FROM target t
JOIN qualifying q ON q.raceId = t.raceId
WHERE q.position IS NOT NULL
  AND q.position > t.position;

SELECT d.nationality
FROM qualifying AS q
JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = q.raceId
JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = q.driverId
WHERE r.year = 2017
  AND r.name = 'Italian Grand Prix'
  AND q.q2 IS NOT NULL
  AND q.q2 = (
    SELECT MIN(q2.q2)
    FROM qualifying AS q2
    WHERE q2.raceId = q.raceId
      AND q2.q2 IS NOT NULL
  );

SELECT d.forename, COUNT(*) AS runners_up_count
FROM results AS res
JOIN races AS race ON race.raceId = res.raceId
JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = res.driverId
WHERE race.name = 'Italian Grand Prix'
  AND res.positionOrder = 2
GROUP BY d.forename
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
