ORDER BY runners_up_count DESC, d.forename ASC;

SELECT d.driverRef AS reference_name, d.nationality, d.dob AS birthday
FROM qualifying AS q
JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = q.raceId
JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = q.driverId
WHERE r.year = 2017
  AND r.name = 'Italian Grand Prix'
  AND q.q2 IS NOT NULL
  AND q.q3 IS NULL
ORDER BY d.driverRef;

WITH q2_times AS (
  SELECT
    d.nationality,
    CAST(substr(q.q2, 1, instr(q.q2, ':') - 1) AS INTEGER) * 60000
      + CAST(substr(q.q2, instr(q.q2, ':') + 1, 2) AS INTEGER) * 1000
      + CAST(round(CAST(substr(q.q2, instr(q.q2, ':') + 4) AS REAL) * 1000) AS INTEGER) AS time_ms
  FROM qualifying AS q
  JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = q.raceId
  JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = q.driverId
  WHERE r.year = 2017
    AND r.name = 'Italian Grand Prix'
    AND q.q2 IS NOT NULL
    AND q.q2 <> '\N'
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT nationality, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY time_ms) AS time_rank
  FROM q2_times
)
SELECT DISTINCT nationality
FROM ranked
WHERE time_rank = 2
ORDER BY nationality;

WITH longest AS (
  SELECT MAX(milliseconds) AS max_ms
  FROM pitStops
  WHERE milliseconds IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
  c.name AS racetrack_name,
  c.location,
  c.country,
  r.year AS season_year,
  ps.duration AS pit_stop_length
FROM pitStops AS ps
JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = ps.raceId
JOIN circuits AS c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId
JOIN longest AS l ON ps.milliseconds = l.max_ms
ORDER BY r.year, c.name;

WITH cohort AS (
  SELECT driverId
  FROM drivers
  WHERE dob >= '1981-01-01' AND dob < '1992-01-01'
),
per_driver AS (
  SELECT c.driverId,
         COUNT(q.q3) AS q3_lap_times
  FROM cohort c
  LEFT JOIN qualifying q ON q.driverId = c.driverId
  GROUP BY c.driverId
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(q3_lap_times), 2) AS avg_q3_lap_times_per_driver
FROM per_driver;

WITH parsed AS (
  SELECT
    d.driverId,
    d.forename,
    d.code,
    CAST(substr(q.q1, 1, instr(q.q1, ':') - 1) AS INTEGER) AS mins,
    CAST(substr(q.q1, instr(q.q1, ':') + 1, 2) AS INTEGER) AS secs,
    CAST(substr(q.q1, instr(q.q1, '.') + 1) AS INTEGER) AS millis
  FROM qualifying q
  JOIN drivers d ON d.driverId = q.driverId
  WHERE q.q1 IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS qualifying_1_times_count
FROM parsed p
WHERE p.mins * 60 + p.secs + p.millis / 1000.0 > 120
  AND (p.code IS NULL OR trim(p.code) = '')
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM drivers d2
    WHERE d2.forename = p.forename
      AND d2.driverId <> p.driverId
  );

SELECT d.driverRef, SUM(r.points) AS points_in_timed_races
FROM drivers AS d
JOIN results AS r ON r.driverId = d.driverId
WHERE d.forename = 'Robert'
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM lapTimes AS lt
    WHERE lt.driverId = r.driverId
      AND lt.raceId = r.raceId
  )
GROUP BY d.driverId, d.driverRef
ORDER BY d.driverRef;

WITH italian_q3 AS (
    SELECT
        d.forename,
        d.surname,
        q.q3
    FROM qualifying AS q
    JOIN drivers AS d
        ON d.driverId = q.driverId
    WHERE d.nationality = 'Italian'
      AND q.q3 IS NOT NULL
),
fastest AS (
    SELECT MIN(
        CAST(substr(q3, 1, instr(q3, ':') - 1) AS INTEGER) * 60000
        + CAST(substr(q3, instr(q3, ':') + 1, instr(q3, '.') - instr(q3, ':') - 1) AS INTEGER) * 1000
        + CAST(substr(q3, instr(q3, '.') + 1) AS INTEGER)
    ) AS fastest_ms
    FROM italian_q3
)
SELECT DISTINCT
    i.forename,
    i.surname,
    i.q3 AS fastest_q3_lap_time
FROM italian_q3 AS i
CROSS JOIN fastest AS f
WHERE CAST(substr(i.q3, 1, instr(i.q3, ':') - 1) AS INTEGER) * 60000
    + CAST(substr(i.q3, instr(i.q3, ':') + 1, instr(i.q3, '.') - instr(i.q3, ':') - 1) AS INTEGER) * 1000
    + CAST(substr(i.q3, instr(i.q3, '.') + 1) AS INTEGER) = f.fastest_ms;

WITH british_q3 AS (
  SELECT
    d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_full_name,
    r.name AS race_name,
    r.year AS race_year,
    q.q3 AS q3_time,
    CAST(substr(q.q3, 1, instr(q.q3, ':') - 1) AS INTEGER) * 60000
      + CAST(substr(q.q3, instr(q.q3, ':') + 1,
          instr(substr(q.q3, instr(q.q3, ':') + 1), '.') - 1) AS INTEGER) * 1000
      + CAST(substr(q.q3, instr(q.q3, '.') + 1) AS INTEGER) AS q3_milliseconds
  FROM qualifying q
  JOIN drivers d ON d.driverId = q.driverId
  JOIN races r ON r.raceId = q.raceId
  WHERE d.nationality = 'British'
    AND CAST(substr(d.dob, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) > 1980
    AND q.q3 IS NOT NULL
    AND q.q3 LIKE '%:%'
    AND q.q3 LIKE '%.%'
)
SELECT driver_full_name, race_name, race_year, q3_time
FROM british_q3
WHERE q3_milliseconds = (SELECT MIN(q3_milliseconds) FROM british_q3)
ORDER BY race_year, race_name, driver_full_name;

WITH second_fastest AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT driverId
    FROM lapTimes
    WHERE position = 2
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.driverId) AS driver_count
FROM second_fastest sf
JOIN drivers d ON d.driverId = sf.driverId
WHERE d.dob >= '1976-01-01';

WITH q3_times AS (
  SELECT
    d.driverRef,
    CAST(substr(q.q3, 1, instr(q.q3, ':') - 1) AS INTEGER) * 60000
      + CAST(substr(q.q3, instr(q.q3, ':') + 1, 2) AS INTEGER) * 1000
      + CAST(substr(q.q3, instr(q.q3, '.') + 1) AS INTEGER) AS time_ms
  FROM qualifying AS q
  JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = q.raceId
  JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = q.driverId
  WHERE r.year = 2017
    AND r.name = 'Italian Grand Prix'
    AND q.q3 IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT driverRef
FROM q3_times
WHERE time_ms = (SELECT MIN(time_ms) FROM q3_times)
ORDER BY driverRef;

SELECT d.forename, COUNT(DISTINCT d.driverId) AS winning_drivers
FROM drivers d
JOIN results r ON r.driverId = d.driverId
WHERE d.forename IN ('Peter', 'John')
  AND r.positionOrder = 1
GROUP BY d.forename
ORDER BY d.forename;

WITH parsed AS (
  SELECT
    q.driverId,
    CAST(substr(q.q3, 1, instr(q.q3, ':') - 1) AS INTEGER) * 60000
    + CAST(
        substr(
          q.q3,
          instr(q.q3, ':') + 1,
          instr(substr(q.q3, instr(q.q3, ':') + 1), '.') - 1
        ) AS INTEGER
      ) * 1000
    + CAST(substr(q.q3, instr(q.q3, '.') + 1) AS INTEGER) AS ms
  FROM qualifying q
  WHERE q.q3 IS NOT NULL
    AND trim(q.q3) <> ''
    AND q.q3 <> '\N'
),
fastest AS (
  SELECT MIN(ms) AS ms
  FROM parsed
)
SELECT DISTINCT d.nationality
FROM parsed p
JOIN fastest f ON p.ms = f.ms
JOIN drivers d ON d.driverId = p.driverId
ORDER BY d.nationality;

WITH credited_fastest_lap AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT constructorId
  FROM results
  WHERE rank = 1
)
SELECT
  c.nationality,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
    WHEN f.constructorId IS NOT NULL THEN c.constructorId
  END) AS constructors_with_fastest_lap
FROM constructors AS c
LEFT JOIN credited_fastest_lap AS f
  ON f.constructorId = c.constructorId
GROUP BY c.nationality
ORDER BY c.nationality;

WITH qualifying_races AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ds.raceId
  FROM driverStandings AS ds
  JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = ds.driverId
  JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = ds.raceId
  WHERE r.year BETWEEN 2002 AND 2013
    AND d.nationality = 'Australian'
    AND ds.position <= 20
),
years AS (
  SELECT 2002 AS year UNION ALL SELECT 2003 UNION ALL SELECT 2004 UNION ALL
  SELECT 2005 UNION ALL SELECT 2006 UNION ALL SELECT 2007 UNION ALL
  SELECT 2008 UNION ALL SELECT 2009 UNION ALL SELECT 2010 UNION ALL
  SELECT 2011 UNION ALL SELECT 2012 UNION ALL SELECT 2013
)
SELECT y.year, COUNT(ps.raceId) AS pit_stop_count
FROM years AS y
LEFT JOIN races AS r ON r.year = y.year
LEFT JOIN qualifying_races AS qr ON qr.raceId = r.raceId
LEFT JOIN pitStops AS ps ON ps.raceId = qr.raceId
GROUP BY y.year
ORDER BY y.year;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT q.driverId) AS driver_count
FROM qualifying AS q
JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = q.raceId
WHERE r.year = 1995
  AND q.q1 IS NOT NULL
  AND q.q1 <> '\N'
  AND (
    CAST(substr(q.q1, 1, instr(q.q1, ':') - 1) AS INTEGER) * 60
    + CAST(substr(q.q1, instr(q.q1, ':') + 1, 2) AS INTEGER)
    + CAST(substr(q.q1, instr(q.q1, '.') + 1) AS REAL) / 1000.0
  ) > 120;

WITH september_stops AS (
  SELECT
    p.driverId,
    p.duration,
    p.milliseconds,
    r.name AS race_name,
    c.name AS circuit_name,
    c.location AS circuit_location
  FROM pitStops AS p
  JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = p.raceId
  JOIN circuits AS c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId
  WHERE r.year = 2016
    AND strftime('%m', r.date) = '09'
    AND p.milliseconds IS NOT NULL
),
fastest AS (
  SELECT MIN(milliseconds) AS milliseconds
  FROM september_stops
)
SELECT
  d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_full_name,
  s.duration AS pit_stop_time,
  s.race_name,
  s.circuit_name,
  s.circuit_location
FROM september_stops AS s
JOIN fastest AS f ON s.milliseconds = f.milliseconds
JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = s.driverId
ORDER BY driver_full_name, race_name;

WITH winning_drivers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT d.driverId, d.forename, d.surname, d.dob, d.nationality
    FROM drivers AS d
    JOIN results AS res ON res.driverId = d.driverId
    JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = res.raceId
    WHERE res.position = 1
      AND r.year BETWEEN 1950 AND 2017
),
oldest_winner AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM winning_drivers
    ORDER BY dob ASC, forename COLLATE NOCASE ASC, surname COLLATE NOCASE ASC
    LIMIT 1
),
career_starts AS (
    SELECT res.driverId, COUNT(*) AS races_started
    FROM results AS res
    JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = res.raceId
    WHERE r.year BETWEEN 1950 AND 2017
    GROUP BY res.driverId
),
first_win AS (
    SELECT res.driverId, r.name AS race_name, r.date AS race_date,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               PARTITION BY res.driverId
               ORDER BY r.date ASC, r.name COLLATE NOCASE ASC
           ) AS rn
    FROM results AS res
    JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = res.raceId
    WHERE res.position = 1
      AND r.year BETWEEN 1950 AND 2017
)
SELECT ow.forename || ' ' || ow.surname AS full_name,
       ow.nationality,
       fw.race_name AS first_race_won,
       fw.race_date AS first_win_date,
       cs.races_started
FROM oldest_winner AS ow
JOIN first_win AS fw ON fw.driverId = ow.driverId AND fw.rn = 1
JOIN career_starts AS cs ON cs.driverId = ow.driverId;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT r.raceId) AS runnings_with_accident_retirement
FROM races r
JOIN results res ON res.raceId = r.raceId
JOIN status s ON s.statusId = res.statusId
WHERE r.name = 'Canadian Grand Prix'
  AND s.status = 'Accident';

WITH ranked_q2 AS (
    SELECT
        d.forename,
        d.surname,
        c.name AS constructor_name,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            ORDER BY
                CASE WHEN q.q2 IS NULL OR TRIM(q.q2) = '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,
                CAST(SUBSTR(q.q2, 1, INSTR(q.q2, ':') - 1) AS INTEGER) * 60000
                  + CAST(SUBSTR(q.q2, INSTR(q.q2, ':') + 1, 2) AS INTEGER) * 1000
                  + CAST(ROUND(CAST(SUBSTR(q.q2, INSTR(q.q2, ':') + 4) AS REAL) * 1000) AS INTEGER),
                r.grid ASC
        ) AS q2_rank
    FROM qualifying q
    JOIN races ra ON ra.raceId = q.raceId
    JOIN drivers d ON d.driverId = q.driverId
    JOIN constructors c ON c.constructorId = q.constructorId
    JOIN results r ON r.raceId = q.raceId AND r.driverId = q.driverId
    WHERE ra.year = 2017
      AND ra.name = 'Italian Grand Prix'
      AND q.q2 IS NOT NULL
      AND TRIM(q.q2) <> ''
)
SELECT forename, surname, constructor_name
FROM ranked_q2
WHERE q2_rank = 2;

WITH times AS (
  SELECT
    d.surname,
    r.name AS race_name,
    CAST(substr(q.q2, 1, instr(q.q2, ':') - 1) AS INTEGER) * 60000
      + CAST(substr(q.q2, instr(q.q2, ':') + 1, 2) AS INTEGER) * 1000
      + CAST(substr(q.q2, instr(q.q2, '.') + 1) AS INTEGER) AS time_ms
  FROM qualifying AS q
  JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = q.raceId
  JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = q.driverId
  WHERE r.year = 2017
    AND q.q2 IS NOT NULL
),
fastest AS (
  SELECT MIN(time_ms) AS time_ms
  FROM times
)
SELECT surname, race_name
FROM times
JOIN fastest USING (time_ms)
ORDER BY race_name, surname;

SELECT q.number
FROM qualifying q
JOIN races r ON r.raceId = q.raceId
WHERE r.year = 2017
  AND r.name = 'Italian Grand Prix'
  AND q.position = 1;

WITH q3_times AS (
  SELECT
    d.code AS driver_code,
    q.q3 AS q3_time,
    CAST(substr(q.q3, 1, instr(q.q3, ':') - 1) AS INTEGER) * 60000 +
    CAST(substr(q.q3, instr(q.q3, ':') + 1, 2) AS INTEGER) * 1000 +
    CAST(substr(q.q3, instr(q.q3, '.') + 1) AS INTEGER) AS time_ms
  FROM qualifying q
  JOIN races r ON r.raceId = q.raceId
  JOIN drivers d ON d.driverId = q.driverId
  WHERE r.year = 2017
    AND r.name = 'Italian Grand Prix'
    AND q.q3 IS NOT NULL
    AND q.q3 <> ''
)
SELECT driver_code, q3_time
FROM q3_times
WHERE time_ms = (SELECT MIN(time_ms) FROM q3_times);

WITH race AS (
  SELECT raceId
  FROM races
  WHERE year = 2017 AND name = 'Italian Grand Prix'
),
fastest AS (
  SELECT MIN(q.q3) AS best_time
  FROM qualifying q
  JOIN race r ON r.raceId = q.raceId
  WHERE q.q3 GLOB '[0-9]*:[0-9]*.[0-9]*'
)
SELECT d.nationality
FROM qualifying q
JOIN race r ON r.raceId = q.raceId
JOIN fastest f ON q.q3 = f.best_time
JOIN drivers d ON d.driverId = q.driverId;

WITH chinese_races AS (
    SELECT raceId, year, time
    FROM races
    WHERE name = 'Chinese Grand Prix'
      AND year BETWEEN 2000 AND 2009
      AND time IS NOT NULL
),
ranked_races AS (
    SELECT raceId, year, time,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY time ASC, year DESC) AS rn
    FROM chinese_races
)
SELECT r.year AS season_year,
       r.time AS scheduled_local_start_time,
       result.time AS runner_up_time_gap_to_winner
FROM ranked_races AS r
JOIN results AS result ON result.raceId = r.raceId
WHERE r.rn = 1
  AND result.positionOrder = 2;

SELECT d.code
FROM qualifying AS q
JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = q.raceId
JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = q.driverId
WHERE r.year = 2017
  AND r.name = 'Italian Grand Prix'
  AND q.q3 IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY d.code ASC;

SELECT r.year AS race_year,
       d.forename,
       d.surname,
       res.time AS winner_finish_time
FROM races AS r
JOIN results AS res ON res.raceId = r.raceId
JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = res.driverId
WHERE r.name = 'Canadian Grand Prix'
  AND r.year BETWEEN 2007 AND 2017
  AND r.time IS NOT NULL
  AND CAST(substr(r.time, 1, 2) AS INTEGER) <= 17
  AND res.positionOrder = 1
ORDER BY r.year;

SELECT d.number AS permanent_career_number, d.surname
FROM qualifying q
JOIN races r ON r.raceId = q.raceId
JOIN drivers d ON d.driverId = q.driverId
WHERE r.year = 2017
  AND r.name = 'Italian Grand Prix'
  AND q.q3 IS NOT NULL
  AND (CAST(substr(q.q3, 1, instr(q.q3, ':') - 1) AS INTEGER) * 60
       + CAST(substr(q.q3, instr(q.q3, ':') + 1) AS REAL)) < 98.000
ORDER BY d.surname;

WITH timed_races AS (
  SELECT
    c.circuitRef,
    CAST(substr(r.time, 1, 2) AS INTEGER) * 3600
      + CAST(substr(r.time, 4, 2) AS INTEGER) * 60
      + CAST(substr(r.time, 7, 2) AS INTEGER) AS start_seconds
  FROM races AS r
  JOIN circuits AS c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId
  WHERE r.time IS NOT NULL
),
extrema AS (
  SELECT MIN(start_seconds) AS earliest_seconds,
         MAX(start_seconds) AS latest_seconds
  FROM timed_races
)
SELECT
  'earliest' AS timing,
  GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT circuitRef) AS circuit_refs,
  earliest_seconds AS start_time_seconds,
  latest_seconds - earliest_seconds AS gap_seconds
FROM timed_races CROSS JOIN extrema
WHERE start_seconds = earliest_seconds
UNION ALL
SELECT
  'latest' AS timing,
  GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT circuitRef) AS circuit_refs,
  latest_seconds AS start_time_seconds,
  latest_seconds - earliest_seconds AS gap_seconds
FROM timed_races CROSS JOIN extrema
WHERE start_seconds = latest_seconds;

WITH driver_highs AS (
  SELECT d.driverId, d.forename, d.surname, d.dob,
         MAX(CAST(r.fastestLapSpeed AS REAL)) AS career_high_speed
  FROM drivers AS d
  JOIN results AS r ON r.driverId = d.driverId
  WHERE d.dob >= '1980-01-01'
    AND d.dob < '1991-01-01'
    AND r.fastestLapSpeed IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY d.driverId, d.forename, d.surname, d.dob
)
SELECT forename || ' ' || surname AS driver_name
FROM driver_highs
ORDER BY career_high_speed DESC, dob ASC, surname COLLATE NOCASE ASC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT d.driverRef
FROM qualifying AS q
JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = q.raceId
JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = q.driverId
WHERE r.year = 2017
  AND r.name = 'Italian Grand Prix'
  AND q.q1 IS NOT NULL
  AND q.q2 IS NULL
ORDER BY q.q1 DESC, q.driverId ASC;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS drivers_withdrew
FROM races AS r
JOIN results AS res ON res.raceId = r.raceId
JOIN status AS s ON s.statusId = res.statusId
WHERE r.year = 1962
  AND r.name = 'British Grand Prix'
  AND s.status = 'Withdrew';

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN s.status = 'Finished' OR s.status LIKE '+% Lap%' OR s.status LIKE '+% Laps%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS classified_finisher_percentage
FROM results r
JOIN races ra ON r.raceId = ra.raceId
JOIN status s ON r.statusId = s.statusId
WHERE ra.year = 1957 AND ra.name = 'British Grand Prix';

WITH event_counts AS (
  SELECT
    e.event_id,
    e.event_name,
    e.event_date,
    COUNT(a.link_to_member) AS student_count
  FROM event AS e
  LEFT JOIN attendance AS a
    ON a.link_to_event = e.event_id
  GROUP BY e.event_id, e.event_name, e.event_date
),
fall_average AS (
  SELECT ROUND(AVG(student_count), 1) AS avg_attendance
  FROM event_counts
  WHERE event_date >= '2019-09-01'
    AND event_date < '2019-12-01'
),
soccer AS (
  SELECT student_count
  FROM event_counts
  WHERE event_name = 'Women''s Soccer'
)
SELECT
  soccer.student_count AS womens_soccer_attendees,
  fall_average.avg_attendance AS fall_2019_average_attendees,
  CASE
    WHEN soccer.student_count > fall_average.avg_attendance THEN 'more'
    WHEN soccer.student_count < fall_average.avg_attendance THEN 'fewer'
    ELSE 'equal'
  END AS verdict
FROM soccer
CROSS JOIN fall_average;

WITH college_departments AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT department
  FROM major
  WHERE college = 'College of Humanities and Social Sciences'
),
department_majors AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT department, major_id, major_name
  FROM major
  WHERE department IN (SELECT department FROM college_departments)
),
major_counts AS (
  SELECT
    dm.department,
    dm.major_id,
    dm.major_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_id) AS member_count
  FROM department_majors AS dm
  LEFT JOIN member AS m
    ON m.link_to_major = dm.major_id
  GROUP BY dm.department, dm.major_id, dm.major_name
)
SELECT
  department AS department_name,
  GROUP_CONCAT(major_name, ', ') AS majors_offered,
  GROUP_CONCAT(
    CASE WHEN member_count > 0 THEN major_name END,
    ', '
  ) AS majors_held_by_members,
  ROUND(AVG(member_count), 2) AS average_members_per_major
FROM major_counts
GROUP BY department
ORDER BY department_name;

WITH ece_college AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT college
  FROM major
  WHERE lower(major_name) LIKE '%electrical%computer%engineering%'
     OR lower(major_name) LIKE '%electrical%computer%'
     OR lower(department) LIKE '%electrical%computer%engineering%'
),
college_departments AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT department
  FROM major
  WHERE college IN (SELECT college FROM ece_college)
),
event_members AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT link_to_member
  FROM attendance
),
member_dues AS (
  SELECT m.link_to_major, SUM(i.amount) AS total_dues
  FROM member AS m
  JOIN event_members AS em ON em.link_to_member = m.member_id
  JOIN income AS i ON i.link_to_member = m.member_id
  WHERE lower(i.source) LIKE '%due%'
     OR lower(i.notes) LIKE '%due%'
  GROUP BY m.link_to_major
)
SELECT d.department AS department_name,
       COALESCE(SUM(md.total_dues), 0) AS total_dues_dollars
FROM college_departments AS d
LEFT JOIN major AS mj ON mj.department = d.department
LEFT JOIN member_dues AS md ON md.link_to_major = mj.major_id
GROUP BY d.department
ORDER BY d.department;

WITH qualifying_budget_lines AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT link_to_budget
  FROM expense
  WHERE cost > 50
),
member_budget_remaining AS (
  SELECT
    e.link_to_member AS member_id,
    SUM(b.remaining) AS total_remaining
  FROM expense e
  JOIN qualifying_budget_lines q
    ON q.link_to_budget = e.link_to_budget
  JOIN budget b
    ON b.budget_id = q.link_to_budget
  GROUP BY e.link_to_member
)
SELECT
  m.first_name,
  m.last_name,
  ROUND(mbr.total_remaining, 2) AS total_amount_left
FROM member_budget_remaining mbr
JOIN member m
  ON m.member_id = mbr.member_id
ORDER BY
  total_amount_left DESC,
  m.last_name ASC,
  m.first_name ASC;

SELECT SUM(i.amount) AS total_dues_dollars
FROM income AS i
JOIN attendance AS a ON a.link_to_member = i.link_to_member
JOIN event AS e ON e.event_id = a.link_to_event
WHERE e.event_name = 'Football'
  AND i.source = 'Dues';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS majors_with_no_enrolled_members
FROM major AS offered
WHERE offered.college = (
    SELECT tyler_major.college
    FROM member AS tyler
    JOIN major AS tyler_major
      ON tyler.link_to_major = tyler_major.major_id
    WHERE tyler.first_name = 'Tyler'
      AND tyler.last_name = 'Hewitt'
)
AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM member
    WHERE member.link_to_major = offered.major_id
);

SELECT ROUND(AVG(member_count), 2) AS average_attendees_per_advertising_budget_event
FROM (
  SELECT e.event_id, COUNT(DISTINCT a.link_to_member) AS member_count
  FROM event AS e
  JOIN budget AS b ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
  LEFT JOIN attendance AS a ON a.link_to_event = e.event_id
  WHERE LOWER(b.category) LIKE '%advertis%'
  GROUP BY e.event_id
) AS event_attendance;

SELECT e.event_name, e.location, COUNT(DISTINCT a.link_to_member) AS attendee_count
FROM event AS e
LEFT JOIN attendance AS a ON a.link_to_event = e.event_id
WHERE LOWER(e.event_name) LIKE '%budget review%'
GROUP BY e.event_id, e.event_name, e.location
ORDER BY e.event_date, e.event_name;

WITH major_counts AS (
    SELECT
        mj.major_name,
        COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_id) AS attendee_count
    FROM attendance AS a
    JOIN event AS e ON e.event_id = a.link_to_event
    JOIN member AS m ON m.member_id = a.link_to_member
    JOIN major AS mj ON mj.major_id = m.link_to_major
    WHERE LOWER(e.event_name) LIKE '%football%'
      AND LOWER(e.event_name) LIKE '%game%'
    GROUP BY mj.major_name
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        major_name,
        attendee_count,
        MAX(attendee_count) OVER () AS max_attendees
    FROM major_counts
)
SELECT major_name, attendee_count
FROM ranked
WHERE attendee_count = max_attendees
ORDER BY major_name;

WITH over_budget_events AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT link_to_event
  FROM budget
  WHERE amount - spent < 0
),
descriptions AS (
  SELECT lower(trim(x.expense_description)) AS d
  FROM expense AS x
  JOIN budget AS b ON b.budget_id = x.link_to_budget
  JOIN over_budget_events AS o ON o.link_to_event = b.link_to_event
),
items AS (
  SELECT trim(value) AS item
  FROM descriptions,
       json_each('["' || replace(replace(d, ', ', '§'), ',', '§') || '"]')
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT lower(trim(replace(item, '§', ',')))) AS different_kinds
FROM items
WHERE trim(item) <> '';

SELECT
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
    WHEN j.college = 'College of Humanities and Social Sciences' THEN m.member_id
  END) AS humanities_social_sciences_members,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
    WHEN j.college IS NULL
      OR j.college <> 'College of Humanities and Social Sciences'
    THEN m.member_id
  END) AS other_or_unmatched_members
FROM member AS m
LEFT JOIN major AS j
  ON m.link_to_major = j.major_id;

WITH vice_president AS (
  SELECT member_id
  FROM member
  WHERE position = 'Vice President'
),
latest_date AS (
  SELECT MAX(e.expense_date) AS expense_date
  FROM expense AS e
  JOIN vice_president AS vp ON e.link_to_member = vp.member_id
)
SELECT latest_date.expense_date,
       SUM(e.cost) AS total_cost
FROM latest_date
JOIN expense AS e ON e.expense_date = latest_date.expense_date
GROUP BY latest_date.expense_date;

SELECT
  e.type AS event_category,
  COUNT(DISTINCT a.link_to_member) AS club_members_attended
FROM event AS e
LEFT JOIN attendance AS a
  ON a.link_to_event = e.event_id
WHERE e.location = 'MU 215'
GROUP BY e.type
ORDER BY e.type;

WITH college_counts AS (
    SELECT ma.college, COUNT(DISTINCT ma.major_id) AS number_of_majors
    FROM member AS me
    JOIN major AS ma ON me.link_to_major = ma.major_id
    GROUP BY ma.college
)
SELECT college, number_of_majors
FROM college_counts
WHERE number_of_majors = (SELECT MAX(number_of_majors) FROM college_counts)
ORDER BY college;

SELECT SUM(b.amount) AS total_budgeted
FROM budget b
JOIN event e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
WHERE e.event_date >= '2019-09-01'
  AND e.event_date < '2019-10-01'
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM expense x
    JOIN budget eb ON x.link_to_budget = eb.budget_id
    WHERE eb.link_to_event = e.event_id
      AND lower(x.expense_description) LIKE '%pizza%'
  );

WITH type_counts AS (
  SELECT e.type, COUNT(DISTINCT a.link_to_member) AS member_count
  FROM event e
  JOIN attendance a ON a.link_to_event = e.event_id
  WHERE e.event_date >= '2019-09-01'
    AND e.event_date < '2020-06-01'
  GROUP BY e.type
)
SELECT type, member_count
FROM type_counts
WHERE member_count = (SELECT MAX(member_count) FROM type_counts)
ORDER BY type;

SELECT e.expense_description AS item_name, COUNT(*) AS record_count
FROM expense e
JOIN budget b ON e.link_to_budget = b.budget_id
WHERE LOWER(b.category) = 'food'
GROUP BY e.expense_description
ORDER BY record_count DESC, item_name ASC
LIMIT 1;

WITH approved_items AS (
    SELECT
        TRIM(item.value) AS item_name,
        b.category,
        e.cost
    FROM expense AS e
    JOIN budget AS b
        ON e.link_to_budget = b.budget_id
    JOIN event AS ev
        ON b.link_to_event = ev.event_id
    JOIN json_each(
        '["' || REPLACE(REPLACE(e.expense_description, '"', '\"'), ', ', '","') || '"]'
    ) AS item
    WHERE ev.event_name = 'October Meeting'
      AND e.approved = 'true'
)
SELECT
    item_name,
    category,
    SUM(cost) AS total_cost_usd
FROM approved_items
GROUP BY category, item_name
ORDER BY category, item_name;

SELECT
  e.expense_description AS item_name,
  COUNT(*) AS purchase_count
FROM expense AS e
JOIN member AS m
  ON e.link_to_member = m.member_id
WHERE m.first_name = 'Sacha'
  AND m.last_name = 'Harrison'
GROUP BY e.expense_description
ORDER BY item_name;

WITH monthly_expenses AS (
  SELECT link_to_member, expense_description, cost
  FROM expense
  WHERE expense_date >= '2019-10-01'
    AND expense_date < '2019-12-01'
),
member_totals AS (
  SELECT
    link_to_member,
    COUNT(DISTINCT expense_description) AS different_kinds,
    SUM(cost) AS total_spending
  FROM monthly_expenses
  GROUP BY link_to_member
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    MAX(different_kinds) OVER () AS max_kinds
  FROM member_totals
)
SELECT
  m.first_name || ' ' || m.last_name AS full_name,
  r.different_kinds,
  r.total_spending
FROM ranked AS r
JOIN member AS m ON m.member_id = r.link_to_member
WHERE r.different_kinds = r.max_kinds
ORDER BY full_name;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT major.major_id) AS different_majors
FROM member
JOIN major ON member.link_to_major = major.major_id
WHERE major.department = 'Political Science Department';

SELECT AVG(CAST(m.height_cm AS REAL)) AS average_height_cm
FROM superhero AS m
JOIN publisher AS mp ON mp.id = m.publisher_id
WHERE mp.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics'
  AND m.height_cm IS NOT NULL
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM hero_power AS mhp
    WHERE mhp.hero_id = m.id
      AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM superhero AS d
        JOIN publisher AS dp ON dp.id = d.publisher_id
        JOIN hero_power AS dhp ON dhp.hero_id = d.id
        WHERE dp.publisher_name = 'DC Comics'
          AND dhp.power_id = mhp.power_id
      )
  );

WITH strength_heroes AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ha.hero_id
  FROM hero_attribute ha
  JOIN attribute a ON a.id = ha.attribute_id
  WHERE a.attribute_name = 'Super Strength'
),
power_counts AS (
  SELECT
    hp.power_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT hp.hero_id) AS total_holders,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN sh.hero_id IS NOT NULL THEN hp.hero_id END) AS strength_holders
  FROM hero_power hp
  LEFT JOIN strength_heroes sh ON sh.hero_id = hp.hero_id
  GROUP BY hp.power_id
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS count
FROM power_counts
WHERE total_holders = strength_holders
  AND strength_holders > 0;

SELECT ROUND(AVG(s.weight_kg), 1) AS average_weight_kg
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN colour AS c ON c.id = s.skin_colour_id
WHERE LOWER(c.colour) = 'green'
  AND s.weight_kg IS NOT NULL;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS count
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN alignment AS a ON a.id = s.alignment_id
WHERE LOWER(TRIM(a.alignment)) NOT IN ('good', 'bad');

WITH intelligence AS (
  SELECT id
  FROM attribute
  WHERE attribute_name = 'Intelligence'
),
abomination_score AS (
  SELECT ha.attribute_value
  FROM superhero AS s
  JOIN hero_attribute AS ha ON ha.hero_id = s.id
  JOIN intelligence AS a ON a.id = ha.attribute_id
  WHERE s.superhero_name = 'Abomination'
),
cohort AS (
  SELECT s.weight_kg
  FROM superhero AS s
  JOIN hero_attribute AS ha ON ha.hero_id = s.id
  JOIN intelligence AS a ON a.id = ha.attribute_id
  WHERE ha.attribute_value = (SELECT attribute_value FROM abomination_score)
    AND s.weight_kg IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(weight_kg), 2) AS average_weight_kg
FROM cohort;

WITH hulk_strength AS (
  SELECT ha.attribute_value
  FROM superhero AS s
  JOIN hero_attribute AS ha ON ha.hero_id = s.id
  JOIN attribute AS a ON a.id = ha.attribute_id
  WHERE s.superhero_name = 'Hulk'
    AND a.attribute_name = 'Strength'
),
matching_heroes AS (
  SELECT s.weight_kg
  FROM superhero AS s
  JOIN hero_attribute AS ha ON ha.hero_id = s.id
  JOIN attribute AS a ON a.id = ha.attribute_id
  JOIN hulk_strength AS hs ON hs.attribute_value = ha.attribute_value
  WHERE a.attribute_name = 'Strength'
    AND s.weight_kg IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT CAST(ROUND(AVG(weight_kg)) AS INTEGER) AS average_weight_kg
FROM matching_heroes;

WITH ranked AS (
  SELECT
    id,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY height_cm DESC) AS height_rank
  FROM superhero
  WHERE height_cm IS NOT NULL
),
tallest AS (
  SELECT id
  FROM ranked
  WHERE height_rank <= 10
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT hp.power_id) AS different_superpowers
FROM tallest t
LEFT JOIN hero_power hp ON hp.hero_id = t.id;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS count_no_race
FROM superhero AS target
JOIN superhero AS abomb ON target.publisher_id = abomb.publisher_id
WHERE abomb.superhero_name = 'A-Bomb'
  AND target.race_id IS NULL;

SELECT ROUND(AVG(power_count), 2) AS average_superpowers_per_hero
FROM (
  SELECT h.id, COUNT(DISTINCT hp.power_id) AS power_count
  FROM superhero AS h
  JOIN race AS r ON h.race_id = r.id
  JOIN gender AS g ON h.gender_id = g.id
  LEFT JOIN hero_power AS hp ON hp.hero_id = h.id
  WHERE r.race IN ('God', 'Eternal')
    AND LOWER(g.gender) = 'male'
  GROUP BY h.id
);

WITH cryo_holders AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT hp.hero_id
  FROM hero_power hp
  JOIN superpower sp ON sp.id = hp.power_id
  WHERE lower(sp.power_name) = 'cryokinesis'
),
related_heroes AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT hp.hero_id
  FROM hero_power hp
  JOIN cryo_holders ch ON ch.hero_id = hp.hero_id
),
hero_counts AS (
  SELECT rh.hero_id, COUNT(DISTINCT hp.power_id) AS power_count
  FROM related_heroes rh
  JOIN hero_power hp ON hp.hero_id = rh.hero_id
  GROUP BY rh.hero_id
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(power_count), 1) AS average_superpowers
FROM hero_counts;

WITH races_without_female AS (
  SELECT s.race_id
  FROM superhero AS s
  LEFT JOIN gender AS g ON s.gender_id = g.id
  GROUP BY s.race_id
  HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN LOWER(g.gender) = 'female' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 0
)
SELECT AVG(CAST(s.weight_kg AS REAL)) AS average_weight_kg
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN races_without_female AS r ON s.race_id = r.race_id
WHERE s.weight_kg IS NOT NULL;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS publisher_count
FROM publisher AS p
JOIN superhero AS s ON s.publisher_id = p.id
WHERE s.height_cm > 200;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_count
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN alignment AS a ON s.alignment_id = a.id
JOIN publisher AS p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
WHERE a.alignment = 'Good'
  AND p.publisher_name <> 'DC Comics';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT h.id) AS hero_count
FROM superhero AS blackwulf
JOIN publisher AS p ON p.id = blackwulf.publisher_id
JOIN superhero AS h ON h.publisher_id = p.id
WHERE blackwulf.superhero_name = 'Blackwulf'
  AND h.eye_colour_id IS NOT NULL
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM superhero AS other
    WHERE other.eye_colour_id = h.eye_colour_id
      AND other.publisher_id IS NOT NULL
      AND other.publisher_id <> p.id
  );

WITH target_publisher AS (
  SELECT publisher_id
  FROM superhero
  WHERE full_name = 'Charles Chandler'
),
race_counts AS (
  SELECT r.race, COUNT(*) AS superhero_count
  FROM superhero AS s
  JOIN race AS r ON r.id = s.race_id
  WHERE s.publisher_id IN (SELECT publisher_id FROM target_publisher)
    AND s.race_id IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY r.id, r.race
)
SELECT race, superhero_count
FROM race_counts
WHERE superhero_count = (SELECT MAX(superhero_count) FROM race_counts);

SELECT ROUND(AVG(s.weight_kg), 2) AS average_weight_kg
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN gender AS g ON g.id = s.gender_id
WHERE g.gender = 'Female'
  AND s.weight_kg IS NOT NULL;

SELECT ROUND(AVG(CAST(ha.attribute_value AS REAL)), 1) AS average_intelligence
FROM hero_attribute AS ha
JOIN attribute AS a ON a.id = ha.attribute_id
JOIN hero_power AS hp ON hp.hero_id = ha.hero_id
JOIN superpower AS p ON p.id = hp.power_id
WHERE LOWER(a.attribute_name) = 'intelligence'
  AND LOWER(p.power_name) IN ('super speed', 'death touch');

WITH per_hero AS (
  SELECT
    s.id,
    g.gender,
    COUNT(hp.power_id) AS power_count
  FROM superhero AS s
  JOIN gender AS g ON g.id = s.gender_id
  LEFT JOIN hero_power AS hp ON hp.hero_id = s.id
  WHERE s.full_name IS NOT NULL
    AND TRIM(s.full_name) <> ''
    AND LOWER(g.gender) IN ('male', 'female')
  GROUP BY s.id, g.gender
)
SELECT
  gender,
  ROUND(AVG(power_count), 2) AS average_superpowers_per_hero
FROM per_hero
GROUP BY gender
ORDER BY CASE LOWER(gender)
  WHEN 'male' THEN 1
  WHEN 'female' THEN 2
END;

SELECT
  ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN s.height_cm IS NOT NULL AND s.height_cm > 0 THEN s.height_cm END), 2) AS average_height_cm,
  ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN s.weight_kg IS NOT NULL AND s.weight_kg > 0 THEN s.weight_kg END), 2) AS average_weight_kg
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN colour AS c ON c.id = s.skin_colour_id
JOIN alignment AS a ON a.id = s.alignment_id
WHERE LOWER(c.colour) = 'green'
  AND LOWER(a.alignment) = 'bad';

SELECT ROUND(AVG(CAST(s.weight_kg AS REAL))) AS avg_weight_kg
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN alignment AS a ON s.alignment_id = a.id
JOIN colour AS c ON s.skin_colour_id = c.id
JOIN hero_power AS hp ON hp.hero_id = s.id
JOIN superpower AS p ON p.id = hp.power_id
WHERE a.alignment = 'Bad'
  AND LOWER(c.colour) LIKE '%green%'
  AND LOWER(p.power_name) LIKE '%flight%'
  AND s.weight_kg IS NOT NULL;

SELECT ROUND(AVG(CAST(s.weight_kg AS REAL)), 2) AS average_weight_kg
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN publisher AS p ON p.id = s.publisher_id
WHERE p.publisher_name = 'George Lucas'
  AND s.weight_kg IS NOT NULL
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM hero_power AS hp
    WHERE hp.hero_id = s.id
  );

SELECT ROUND(AVG(CAST(s.weight_kg AS REAL)), 2) AS average_weight_kg
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN gender AS g ON g.id = s.gender_id
JOIN alignment AS a ON a.id = s.alignment_id
WHERE LOWER(g.gender) = 'female'
  AND LOWER(a.alignment) = 'good'
  AND s.weight_kg IS NOT NULL;

WITH lightest AS (
  SELECT MIN(weight_kg) AS min_weight
  FROM superhero
  WHERE weight_kg IS NOT NULL
),
power_counts AS (
  SELECT h.id, COUNT(DISTINCT hp.power_id) AS power_count
  FROM superhero AS h
  LEFT JOIN hero_power AS hp ON hp.hero_id = h.id
  WHERE h.weight_kg = (SELECT min_weight FROM lightest)
  GROUP BY h.id
)
SELECT COALESCE(MAX(power_count), 0) AS max_power_count
FROM power_counts;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS count
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN alignment AS a ON s.alignment_id = a.id
WHERE LOWER(a.alignment) = 'neutral'
  AND s.full_name IS NOT NULL
  AND TRIM(s.full_name) <> '';

WITH brown_hero_eyes AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT hero.eye_colour_id
    FROM superhero AS hero
    JOIN colour AS hair ON hair.id = hero.hair_colour_id
    WHERE LOWER(hair.colour) = 'brown'
      AND hero.eye_colour_id IS NOT NULL
),
eye_counts AS (
    SELECT hero.eye_colour_id, COUNT(*) AS hero_count
    FROM superhero AS hero
    JOIN colour AS hair ON hair.id = hero.hair_colour_id
    WHERE LOWER(hair.colour) <> 'brown'
      AND hero.eye_colour_id IN (SELECT eye_colour_id FROM brown_hero_eyes)
    GROUP BY hero.eye_colour_id
)
SELECT eye.colour AS eye_colour,
       COALESCE(eye_counts.hero_count, 0) AS hero_count
FROM brown_hero_eyes
JOIN colour AS eye ON eye.id = brown_hero_eyes.eye_colour_id
LEFT JOIN eye_counts ON eye_counts.eye_colour_id = brown_hero_eyes.eye_colour_id
ORDER BY hero_count DESC, eye.colour ASC;

SELECT ROUND(
  100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN a.alignment = 'Good' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*),
  2
) AS good_percentage
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN publisher AS p ON p.id = s.publisher_id
LEFT JOIN alignment AS a ON a.id = s.alignment_id
WHERE p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics'
  AND s.full_name IS NOT NULL
  AND TRIM(s.full_name) <> '';

SELECT ROUND(
  100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN a.alignment = 'Good' THEN s.id END)
  / COUNT(DISTINCT s.id),
  2
) AS percentage
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN publisher AS pub ON pub.id = s.publisher_id
JOIN alignment AS a ON a.id = s.alignment_id
JOIN hero_power AS hp ON hp.hero_id = s.id
WHERE pub.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics';

SELECT
  (SELECT COUNT(*)
   FROM superhero AS s
   JOIN colour AS c ON c.id = s.eye_colour_id
   WHERE s.weight_kg IS NULL AND c.colour = 'No Colour')
  -
  (SELECT COUNT(*)
   FROM superhero AS s
   JOIN colour AS c ON c.id = s.eye_colour_id
   WHERE s.weight_kg IS NULL AND LOWER(c.colour) = 'blue') AS difference;

WITH above_limit AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT l.ID, p.SEX
  FROM Laboratory AS l
  JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = l.ID
  WHERE l.UA IS NOT NULL
    AND ((p.SEX = 'M' AND l.UA > 7.0) OR (p.SEX = 'F' AND l.UA > 6.0))
),
counts AS (
  SELECT
    COUNT(CASE WHEN SEX = 'M' THEN 1 END) AS male_patients,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN SEX = 'F' THEN 1 END) AS female_patients
  FROM above_limit
)
SELECT male_patients, female_patients,
       CAST(male_patients AS REAL) / NULLIF(female_patients, 0) AS male_to_female_ratio
FROM counts;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT l.ID) AS patient_count
FROM Laboratory AS l
JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.CRP IS NOT NULL
  AND TRIM(l.CRP) <> ''
  AND LOWER(TRIM(l.CRP)) IN ('positive', 'pos', '+', '1')
  AND p.Description IS NULL;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS patient_count
FROM Patient AS p
WHERE p.SEX = 'F'
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Laboratory AS l
    WHERE l.ID = p.ID
      AND LOWER(TRIM(l.SC170)) = 'normal'
  )
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Examination AS e
    WHERE e.ID = p.ID
      AND e.Symptoms IS NOT NULL
  );

WITH strongest_rnp AS (
    SELECT
        ID,
        Date,
        CAST(REPLACE(RNP, '>', '') AS REAL) AS rnp_value,
        CASE WHEN RNP LIKE '>%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_censored
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE RNP IS NOT NULL
      AND TRIM(RNP) <> ''
),
max_rnp AS (
    SELECT MAX(rnp_value) AS max_value,
           MAX(is_censored) AS max_censored
    FROM strongest_rnp
),
top_rnp_tests AS (
    SELECT s.ID, s.Date
    FROM strongest_rnp AS s
    CROSS JOIN max_rnp AS m
    WHERE s.rnp_value = m.max_value
      AND s.is_censored = m.max_censored
),
with_bilirubin AS (
    SELECT t.ID, t.Date, l.`T-BIL` AS total_bilirubin
    FROM top_rnp_tests AS t
    JOIN Laboratory AS l
      ON l.ID = t.ID AND l.Date = t.Date
),
highest_bilirubin AS (
    SELECT MAX(total_bilirubin) AS max_bilirubin
    FROM with_bilirubin
)
SELECT b.total_bilirubin AS total_bilirubin_level,
       b.Date AS lab_test_date,
       p.ID AS patient_id,
       p.SEX AS sex,
       p.Birthday AS birthday
FROM with_bilirubin AS b
JOIN highest_bilirubin AS h
  ON b.total_bilirubin = h.max_bilirubin
JOIN Patient AS p
  ON p.ID = b.ID
ORDER BY b.Date, p.ID;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS patient_count
FROM Patient AS p
WHERE p.Birthday > '1960-01-01'
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Examination AS e
    WHERE e.ID = p.ID
      AND e.Thrombosis = 1
  )
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Laboratory AS l
    WHERE l.ID = p.ID
      AND l.RNP IS NOT NULL
      AND LOWER(TRIM(l.RNP)) <> 'negative'
      AND CAST(TRIM(l.RNP) AS REAL) > 10
  );

WITH never_examined AS (
  SELECT p.ID, p.SEX
  FROM Patient AS p
  WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Examination AS e
    WHERE e.ID = p.ID
  )
),
per_patient AS (
  SELECT n.ID, n.SEX, COUNT(DISTINCT l.Date) AS lab_test_dates
  FROM never_examined AS n
  LEFT JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = n.ID
  WHERE n.SEX IN ('F', 'M')
  GROUP BY n.ID, n.SEX
)
SELECT SEX, ROUND(AVG(lab_test_dates), 2) AS average_laboratory_test_dates
FROM per_patient
GROUP BY SEX
ORDER BY SEX;

SELECT RNP
FROM Laboratory
WHERE RNP IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY CAST(RNP AS REAL) DESC
LIMIT 1;

WITH sle_female_ids AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT e.ID
    FROM Examination AS e
    JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = e.ID
    WHERE LOWER(p.SEX) = 'f'
      AND e.Diagnosis IS NOT NULL
      AND (',' || REPLACE(e.Diagnosis, ' ', '') || ',') LIKE '%,SLE,%'
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(l.TP - 8.5), 3) AS average_deviation
FROM Laboratory AS l
JOIN sle_female_ids AS s ON s.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.TP > 8.5;

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN date(Birthday) >= '1960-01-01' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 1) AS percentage_born_1960_or_later
FROM Patient
WHERE LOWER(Diagnosis) LIKE '%psoriatic arthritis%'
  AND Birthday IS NOT NULL;

SELECT p.SEX AS sex, COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS patient_count
FROM Patient AS p
JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID
WHERE l.ALB < 3.5
  AND p.SEX IN ('F', 'M')
GROUP BY p.SEX
ORDER BY p.SEX;

WITH qualifying_patients AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ID
  FROM Laboratory
  WHERE CAST("U-PRO" AS REAL) IN (3, 4)
     OR CAST("U-PRO" AS REAL) >= 300
)
SELECT AVG(1999 - CAST(strftime('%Y', p.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) AS average_age_years
FROM Patient AS p
JOIN qualifying_patients AS q ON q.ID = p.ID
WHERE p.Birthday IS NOT NULL;

WITH qualifying AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ID
  FROM Laboratory
  WHERE CAST(RNP AS REAL) > 32
)
SELECT
  SUM(CASE WHEN UPPER(p.SEX) IN ('F', 'FEMALE') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS women,
  SUM(CASE WHEN UPPER(p.SEX) IN ('M', 'MALE') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS men
FROM Patient AS p
JOIN qualifying AS q ON q.ID = p.ID;

WITH psoriatic_patients AS (
  SELECT ID
  FROM Patient
  WHERE LOWER(Diagnosis) LIKE '%psoriatic arthritis%'
),
patient_lab_counts AS (
  SELECT p.ID, COUNT(l.ID) AS lab_count
  FROM psoriatic_patients AS p
  LEFT JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID
  GROUP BY p.ID
)
SELECT
  COALESCE(SUM(lab_count), 0) AS total_laboratory_tests,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN lab_count = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS patients_with_no_laboratory_tests
FROM patient_lab_counts;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS patient_count
FROM Patient AS p
JOIN Examination AS e ON e.ID = p.ID
WHERE LOWER(COALESCE(p.Diagnosis, '')) LIKE '%thrombosis%'
  AND LOWER(COALESCE(e.Diagnosis, '')) LIKE '%thrombosis%'
  AND e.Thrombosis = 1
  AND date(e."Examination Date") >= date('1997-01-01')
  AND date(e."Examination Date") < date('1998-01-01');

WITH sle_patients AS (
  SELECT ID
  FROM Patient
  WHERE Diagnosis LIKE '%SLE%'
),
symptom_counts AS (
  SELECT TRIM(j.value) AS symptom, COUNT(*) AS episode_count
  FROM Examination AS e
  JOIN sle_patients AS p ON p.ID = e.ID
  JOIN json_each(
    '[' || '"' ||
    REPLACE(REPLACE(COALESCE(e.Symptoms, ''), '"', '\\\"'), ',', '","') ||
    '"' || ']'
  ) AS j
  WHERE e.Thrombosis = 1
    AND TRIM(j.value) <> ''
  GROUP BY TRIM(j.value)
)
SELECT symptom
FROM symptom_counts
ORDER BY episode_count DESC, symptom COLLATE NOCASE ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT ROUND(
    100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN UPPER(TRIM("Diagnosis")) = 'SLE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
    / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0),
    2
) AS percentage
FROM Examination
WHERE "Thrombosis" = 1;

WITH eligible AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT l.ID
  FROM Laboratory AS l
  WHERE l.LDH > 600
    AND l.LDH < 800
    AND CAST(
      REPLACE(REPLACE(LOWER(l.`U-PRO`), 'at least', ''), ' ', '')
      AS REAL
    ) >= 300
)
SELECT
  p.ID AS patient_id,
  CAST(
    strftime('%Y', '2026-10-09') - strftime('%Y', p.Birthday)
    - (strftime('%m-%d', '2026-10-09') < strftime('%m-%d', p.Birthday))
    AS INTEGER
  ) AS age
FROM eligible AS e
JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = e.ID
ORDER BY patient_id;

WITH thrombosis_patients AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT p.ID, p.SEX
  FROM Patient AS p
  JOIN Examination AS e ON e.ID = p.ID
  WHERE e.Thrombosis = 1
),
sexes AS (
  SELECT 'M' AS SEX
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'F'
),
creatinine_abnormal AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT t.ID
  FROM thrombosis_patients AS t
  JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = t.ID
  WHERE l.CRE >= 1.5
)
SELECT
  s.SEX,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN a.ID IS NOT NULL THEN t.ID END) AS patients_with_creatinine_ge_1_5,
  COUNT(DISTINCT t.ID) AS total_patients,
  ROUND(
    100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN a.ID IS NOT NULL THEN t.ID END)
    / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT t.ID), 0),
    1
  ) AS percentage
FROM sexes AS s
LEFT JOIN thrombosis_patients AS t ON t.SEX = s.SEX
LEFT JOIN creatinine_abnormal AS a ON a.ID = t.ID
GROUP BY s.SEX
ORDER BY CASE s.SEX WHEN 'M' THEN 1 WHEN 'F' THEN 2 END;

WITH maxima AS (
  SELECT
    P.Admission,
    MAX(L."T-CHO") AS max_tcho
  FROM Laboratory AS L
  JOIN Patient AS P ON P.ID = L.ID
  WHERE P.Admission IN ('+', '-')
    AND L."T-CHO" IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY P.Admission
)
SELECT
  M.max_tcho AS "highest T-CHO",
  P.Admission AS "admission status",
  P.ID AS "patient ID"
FROM maxima AS M
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON L."T-CHO" = M.max_tcho
JOIN Patient AS P
  ON P.ID = L.ID
  AND P.Admission = M.Admission
ORDER BY CASE P.Admission WHEN '+' THEN 0 WHEN '-' THEN 1 END, P.ID;

WITH numeric_levels AS (
  SELECT p.ID, CAST(l.RNP AS REAL) AS level
  FROM Patient AS p
  JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID
  WHERE strftime('%Y', p."First Date") = '1991'
    AND l.RNP IS NOT NULL
    AND trim(l.RNP) <> ''
    AND CAST(l.RNP AS REAL) IS NOT NULL
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT ID, level, MAX(level) OVER () AS max_level
  FROM numeric_levels
)
SELECT DISTINCT ID, level AS anti_RNP_level
FROM ranked
WHERE level = max_level
ORDER BY ID;

WITH latest_lab AS (
  SELECT ID, MAX(Date) AS latest_date
  FROM Laboratory
  GROUP BY ID
),
latest_scl70 AS (
  SELECT ID, SC170,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ID ORDER BY Date DESC) AS rn
  FROM Laboratory
)
SELECT p.ID
FROM Patient AS p
JOIN latest_lab AS l ON l.ID = p.ID
JOIN latest_scl70 AS s ON s.ID = p.ID AND s.rn = 1
WHERE l.latest_date > '1997-01-01'
  AND s.SC170 = 'normal'
ORDER BY p.ID;

WITH per_patient AS (
  SELECT
    ID,
    MAX(CASE
      WHEN SSA IS NOT NULL
       AND LOWER(TRIM(SSA)) NOT IN ('negative', '0', 'none', '')
      THEN 1 ELSE 0
    END) AS abnormal_ssa,
    MAX(CASE
      WHEN `U-PRO` IS NOT NULL
       AND LOWER(TRIM(`U-PRO`)) NOT IN ('negative', 'none', '')
      THEN 1 ELSE 0
    END) AS positive_proteinuria
  FROM Laboratory
  GROUP BY ID
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS patient_count
FROM per_patient
WHERE abnormal_ssa = 1
  AND positive_proteinuria = 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS patient_count
FROM Patient AS p
JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID
WHERE p.SEX = 'F'
  AND CAST(l.DNA AS REAL) < 8

SELECT COUNT(*) AS count
FROM Patient AS p
WHERE p.Admission = '+'
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Laboratory AS l
    WHERE l.ID = p.ID
      AND l.ALP > 340
  );

SELECT MAX(CAST(l.RNP AS REAL)) AS max_anti_RNP
FROM Laboratory AS l
WHERE l.CRE < 1.5
  AND l.RNP IS NOT NULL
  AND TRIM(l.RNP) <> '';

WITH severe_anemia AS (
  SELECT p.ID, p.SEX
  FROM Patient AS p
  JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID
  WHERE l.HGB < 8
    AND lower(p.SEX) IN ('female', 'male')
  GROUP BY p.ID, p.SEX
)
SELECT lower(SEX) AS sex, COUNT(*) AS patient_count
FROM severe_anemia
GROUP BY lower(SEX)
ORDER BY sex;

WITH eligible AS (
  SELECT
    ID,
    Date,
    RNP,
    CAST(RNP AS REAL) AS rnp_value
  FROM Laboratory
  WHERE GOT >= 60
    AND RNP IS NOT NULL
    AND TRIM(RNP) <> ''
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    ID,
    Date,
    RNP,
    rnp_value,
    MAX(rnp_value) OVER () AS max_rnp
  FROM eligible
)
SELECT
  p.ID AS patient_id,
  r.Date AS laboratory_test_date,
  r.RNP AS anti_ribonuclear_protein_reading
FROM ranked AS r
JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = r.ID
WHERE r.rnp_value = r.max_rnp
ORDER BY p.ID, r.Date;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS patient_count
FROM Patient p
WHERE p.Birthday > '1980-01-01'
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Laboratory l
    WHERE l.ID = p.ID
      AND (
        l.FG < 150 OR l.FG > 450
        OR TRIM(l."U-PRO") IN ('3+', '4+')
      )
  );

SELECT
  COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS patients_with_any_laboratory_result,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
    WHEN l."T-BIL" > 1.0 THEN p.ID
  END) AS patients_with_elevated_total_bilirubin
FROM Patient AS p
JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID
WHERE p.SEX IS NULL OR TRIM(p.SEX) = '';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS patient_count
FROM Patient AS p
JOIN Examination AS e ON e.ID = p.ID
WHERE lower(p.SEX) = 'female'
  AND p.Admission IS NOT NULL
  AND CAST(strftime('%Y', p.Birthday) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 1945 AND 1989
  AND e.ANA IS NOT NULL
  AND e.ANA <> 0
  AND TRIM(e."ANA Pattern") = 'P';

WITH eligible_patients AS (
  SELECT p.ID, p.SEX
  FROM Patient AS p
  WHERE LOWER(p.Admission) LIKE '%outpatient%'
    AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM Laboratory AS l
      WHERE l.ID = p.ID
        AND l.HGB < 10
    )
),
patient_maxima AS (
  SELECT ep.ID, ep.SEX, MAX(CAST(l.RNP AS REAL)) AS highest_rnp
  FROM eligible_patients AS ep
  JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = ep.ID
  WHERE l.RNP IS NOT NULL
    AND TRIM(l.RNP) <> ''
  GROUP BY ep.ID, ep.SEX
)
SELECT ID, SEX, highest_rnp
FROM patient_maxima
WHERE highest_rnp = (SELECT MAX(highest_rnp) FROM patient_maxima);

WITH first_lab AS (
  SELECT ID, GOT, RNP,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ID ORDER BY Date) AS rn
  FROM Laboratory
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS patient_count
FROM first_lab
WHERE rn = 1
  AND GOT < 60
  AND CAST(RNP AS REAL) > 10;

WITH proteinuria_ranked AS (
  SELECT
    l.ID,
    l.Date,
    l."U-PRO",
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY l.ID
      ORDER BY l.Date DESC
    ) AS rn
  FROM Laboratory AS l
  WHERE l."U-PRO" IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
  p.ID AS patient_identifier,
  p.SEX AS sex,
  pr.Date AS most_recent_proteinuria_test_date,
  pr."U-PRO" AS proteinuria_level
FROM proteinuria_ranked AS pr
JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = pr.ID
WHERE pr.rn = 1;

WITH elevated AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ID
  FROM Laboratory
  WHERE CAST(RNP AS REAL) >= 16
),
normal_gpt AS (
  SELECT ID, MAX(GPT) AS max_gpt
  FROM Laboratory
  WHERE GPT < 60
  GROUP BY ID
)
SELECT p.Birthday
FROM elevated e
JOIN normal_gpt n ON n.ID = e.ID
JOIN Patient p ON p.ID = e.ID
ORDER BY n.max_gpt DESC, e.ID ASC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS female_patient_count
FROM Patient AS p
JOIN Examination AS e ON e.ID = p.ID
JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID
WHERE p.SEX = 'F'
  AND e.Thrombosis = 1
  AND l.PT < 14
  AND CAST(l.RNP AS REAL) >= 16;

WITH inpatient_tests AS (
  SELECT
    l.ID,
    l.Date AS test_date,
    l.DNA AS dna_text,
    l."DNA-II" AS dna_level,
    p.Birthday,
    p.Diagnosis AS patient_diagnosis,
    e.Diagnosis AS examination_diagnosis
  FROM Laboratory AS l
  JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = l.ID
  LEFT JOIN Examination AS e ON e.ID = l.ID
  WHERE p.Admission = '+'
    AND (l.DNA IS NOT NULL OR l."DNA-II" IS NOT NULL)
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT *,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
           ORDER BY COALESCE(CAST(dna_text AS REAL), CAST(dna_level AS REAL)) DESC,
                    test_date ASC
         ) AS rn
  FROM inpatient_tests
)
SELECT
  ID,
  test_date,
  COALESCE(CAST(dna_text AS REAL), CAST(dna_level AS REAL)) AS anti_dna_level,
  CAST(strftime('%Y', test_date) AS INTEGER)
    - CAST(strftime('%Y', Birthday) AS INTEGER)
    - (strftime('%m-%d', test_date) < strftime('%m-%d', Birthday)) AS age_years,
  COALESCE(examination_diagnosis, patient_diagnosis) AS diagnosis
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1;

WITH eligible AS (
  SELECT
    p.ID,
    CASE
      WHEN p.Admission = '+' THEN 'Admitted to the hospital'
      WHEN p.Admission = '-' THEN 'Followed at the outpatient clinic'
    END AS care_setting,
    CASE
      WHEN EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM Laboratory l
        WHERE l.ID = p.ID
          AND CAST(l.RNP AS REAL) >= 4
      ) THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS has_elevated_rnp
  FROM Patient p
  WHERE p.SEX = 'F'
    AND p.Admission IN ('+', '-')
    AND p.Birthday IS NOT NULL
    AND date(p.Birthday, '+50 years') <= date('2026-10-09')
)
SELECT
  care_setting,
  SUM(has_elevated_rnp) AS patients_with_at_least_one_rnp_ge_4,
  COUNT(*) - SUM(has_elevated_rnp) AS patients_with_no_rnp_ge_4
FROM eligible
GROUP BY care_setting
ORDER BY care_setting;

WITH sle_patients AS (
  SELECT ID, Diagnosis
  FROM Patient
  WHERE Diagnosis LIKE '%SLE%'

  UNION

  SELECT p.ID, p.Diagnosis
  FROM Patient AS p
  JOIN Examination AS e ON e.ID = p.ID
  WHERE e.Diagnosis LIKE '%SLE%'
),
dna_values AS (
  SELECT
    s.ID,
    s.Diagnosis,
    l.DNA,
    CAST(l.DNA AS REAL) AS numeric_dna
  FROM sle_patients AS s
  JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = s.ID
  WHERE l.DNA IS NOT NULL
    AND trim(l.DNA) <> ''
),
max_dna AS (
  SELECT MAX(numeric_dna) AS value
  FROM dna_values
)
SELECT
  d.ID AS patient_id,
  d.Diagnosis AS diagnosis,
  d.DNA AS highest_anti_DNA_result
FROM dna_values AS d
JOIN max_dna AS m ON d.numeric_dna = m.value
ORDER BY d.ID;

WITH patient_latest AS (
  SELECT
    l.ID,
    l.RNP,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY l.ID ORDER BY l.Date DESC) AS rn
  FROM Laboratory AS l
),
patient_status AS (
  SELECT p.SEX, pl.RNP
  FROM patient_latest AS pl
  JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = pl.ID
  WHERE pl.rn = 1
)
SELECT COALESCE(
  SUM(
    CASE
      WHEN SEX = 'F' AND CAST(RNP AS REAL) >= 32 THEN 1
      WHEN SEX = 'M' AND CAST(RNP AS REAL) >= 32 THEN -1
      ELSE 0
    END
  ),
  0
) AS female_minus_male
FROM patient_status;

WITH latest AS (
  SELECT
    p.ID,
    l.RNP,
    l.CPK,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p.ID ORDER BY l.Date DESC) AS rn
  FROM Patient AS p
  JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID
  WHERE p.SEX = 'F'
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS patient_count
FROM latest
WHERE rn = 1
  AND CAST(RNP AS REAL) > 64
  AND CPK < 250;

WITH qualifying AS (
  SELECT ID
  FROM Laboratory
  GROUP BY ID
  HAVING MAX(CASE WHEN LDH >= 500 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 1
     AND MAX(CASE WHEN CAST("U-PRO" AS REAL) >= 100 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 1
)
SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, p.Birthday
FROM Patient AS p
JOIN qualifying AS q ON q.ID = p.ID
ORDER BY p.ID;

SELECT p.SEX AS sex, COUNT(*) AS patient_count
FROM Patient AS p
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1
  FROM Examination AS e
  WHERE e.ID = p.ID
)
GROUP BY p.SEX
ORDER BY p.SEX;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS patient_count
FROM Patient
WHERE LOWER(TRIM(SEX)) = 'female'
  AND "First Date" >= '1998-01-01'
  AND "First Date" < '1999-01-01'
  AND Admission IS NOT NULL
  AND TRIM(Admission) <> '';

WITH qualifying AS (
  SELECT
    p.ID AS patient_id,
    p.Birthday AS birthday,
    p.Diagnosis AS overall_diagnosis,
    e."Examination Date" AS examination_date,
    e.Symptoms AS symptoms
  FROM Patient AS p
  JOIN Examination AS e ON e.ID = p.ID
  WHERE e.Diagnosis LIKE '%SLE%'
    AND e.Symptoms IS NOT NULL
    AND TRIM(e.Symptoms) <> ''
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT *,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
           ORDER BY birthday ASC, patient_id ASC, examination_date DESC
         ) AS rn
  FROM qualifying
)
SELECT patient_id, birthday, symptoms, overall_diagnosis
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1;

WITH diagnosis_terms AS (
  SELECT
    "aCL IgM" AS acl_igm
  FROM Examination
  WHERE "Examination Date" >= '1993-10-01'
    AND "Examination Date" < '1993-11-01'
    AND UPPER("Diagnosis") LIKE '%SLE%'
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(acl_igm), 1) AS average_acl_igm
FROM diagnosis_terms;

SELECT
  CASE p.SEX WHEN 'M' THEN 'male' WHEN 'F' THEN 'female' END AS sex,
  COUNT(*) AS patient_count
FROM Patient AS p
WHERE p.SEX IN ('M', 'F')
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Laboratory AS l
    WHERE l.ID = p.ID
      AND l.GPT > 40
  )
GROUP BY p.SEX
ORDER BY CASE p.SEX WHEN 'M' THEN 1 WHEN 'F' THEN 2 END;

WITH low_rbc_patients AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ID
  FROM Laboratory
  WHERE RBC < 3.5
),
patient_ages AS (
  SELECT
    p.ID,
    p.Admission AS care_setting,
    CAST(strftime('%Y', '2026-10-09') AS INTEGER)
      - CAST(strftime('%Y', p.Birthday) AS INTEGER)
      - (strftime('%m-%d', '2026-10-09') < strftime('%m-%d', p.Birthday)) AS completed_age
  FROM Patient AS p
  JOIN low_rbc_patients AS r ON r.ID = p.ID
  WHERE p.Admission IN ('+', '-')
)
SELECT
  care_setting,
  COUNT(DISTINCT ID) AS patient_count,
  ROUND(AVG(completed_age), 1) AS average_completed_age
FROM patient_ages
GROUP BY care_setting
ORDER BY care_setting;

SELECT ROUND(AVG(CAST(e."aCL IgM" AS REAL)), 2) AS average_acl_igm
FROM Examination AS e
JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = e.ID
WHERE p.Diagnosis = 'SJS'
  AND e."aCL IgM" IS NOT NULL
  AND e."aCL IgM" <> 0;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS female_patients_with_sjs_diagnosis
FROM Patient p
JOIN Examination e ON e.ID = p.ID
WHERE LOWER(TRIM(p.SEX)) IN ('f', 'female')
  AND (
    LOWER(COALESCE(e.Diagnosis, '')) LIKE '%sjögren%'
    OR LOWER(COALESCE(e.Diagnosis, '')) LIKE '%sjogren%'
    OR LOWER(COALESCE(e.Diagnosis, '')) LIKE '%sjs%'
  )
  AND LOWER(COALESCE(e.Diagnosis, '')) NOT LIKE '%suspect%'
  AND LOWER(COALESCE(e.Diagnosis, '')) NOT LIKE '%suspected%';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS patient_count
FROM Patient AS p
JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID
WHERE TRIM(COALESCE(p.Admission, '')) = '-'
  AND (
    LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(l.RNP, ''))) IN ('negative', 'neg', '-', '0', '0.0')
    OR (
      TRIM(COALESCE(l.RNP, '')) <> ''
      AND CAST(l.RNP AS REAL) = 0
    )
  );

WITH eligible AS (
  SELECT p.ID
  FROM Patient p
  WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Laboratory l
    WHERE l.ID = p.ID
      AND LOWER(TRIM(l.SM)) IN ('negative', '0')
  )
    AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM Examination e
      WHERE e.ID = p.ID
    )
    AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM Examination e
      WHERE e.ID = p.ID
        AND e.Thrombosis IS NOT NULL
        AND e.Thrombosis <> 0
    )
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT eligible.ID) AS patient_count
FROM eligible
WHERE EXISTS (
  SELECT 1
  FROM Laboratory l
  WHERE l.ID = eligible.ID
    AND TRIM(l."U-PRO") NOT IN ('-', 'TR')
    AND CAST(TRIM(l."U-PRO") AS REAL) >= 30
)
LIMIT 1000;

WITH eligible AS (
  SELECT
    p.ID,
    (julianday('2026-10-09') - julianday(p.Birthday)) / 365.2425 AS age_years
  FROM Patient AS p
  WHERE p.Birthday IS NOT NULL
    AND (julianday('2026-10-09') - julianday(p.Birthday)) / 365.2425 < 70
    AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM Laboratory AS l
      WHERE l.ID = p.ID
        AND CAST(l.RNP AS REAL) >= 64
    )
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(age_years), 1) AS average_age_years
FROM eligible;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS patient_count
FROM Patient AS p
JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID
WHERE LOWER(p.SEX) IN ('f', 'female')
  AND l.WBC IS NOT NULL
  AND l.WBC BETWEEN 4.0 AND 10.0
  AND l.FG IS NOT NULL
  AND l.FG < 200
  AND CAST(l.RNP AS REAL) > 15;

WITH eligible AS (
    SELECT p.ID, p.SEX
    FROM Patient p
    WHERE p.Birthday >= '1936-01-01'
      AND p.Birthday < '1957-01-01'
      AND p.SEX IN ('F', 'M', 'Female', 'Male', '女', '男')
      AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM Laboratory l
          WHERE l.ID = p.ID
            AND l.CPK >= 250
      )
),
counts AS (
    SELECT
        SUM(CASE WHEN SEX IN ('F', 'Female', '女') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS women,
        SUM(CASE WHEN SEX IN ('M', 'Male', '男') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS men
    FROM eligible
)
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * women / NULLIF(women + men, 0), 1) AS women_percentage
FROM counts;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT l.ID) AS patient_count
FROM Laboratory AS l
JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.Date >= '1981-01-01'
  AND l.Date < '1987-01-01'
  AND p.Birthday IS NOT NULL
  AND (
    CAST(strftime('%Y', l.Date) AS INTEGER)
    - CAST(strftime('%Y', p.Birthday) AS INTEGER)
    - (strftime('%m-%d', l.Date) < strftime('%m-%d', p.Birthday))
  ) < 50
  AND l.PLT BETWEEN 100 AND 400
  AND l."U-PRO" IS NOT NULL
  AND TRIM(l."U-PRO") <> ''
  AND UPPER(TRIM(l."U-PRO")) NOT IN ('-', 'NEGATIVE', 'NEG', '0', 'NO');

WITH element_counts AS (
  SELECT a.element, COUNT(*) AS atom_occurrences
  FROM atom AS a
  JOIN molecule AS m ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
  WHERE m.label = '-'
  GROUP BY a.element
)
SELECT element, atom_occurrences
FROM element_counts
WHERE atom_occurrences = (SELECT MIN(atom_occurrences) FROM element_counts)
ORDER BY element;

WITH carcinogenic AS (
  SELECT molecule_id
  FROM molecule
  WHERE label = '+'
),
fluorinated AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT molecule_id
  FROM atom
  WHERE LOWER(element) = 'f'
),
totals AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_count
  FROM carcinogenic
),
no_fluorine AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) AS no_f_count
  FROM carcinogenic AS c
  LEFT JOIN fluorinated AS f ON f.molecule_id = c.molecule_id
  WHERE f.molecule_id IS NULL
)
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * no_f_count / total_count, 2) AS percentage_no_fluorine
FROM no_fluorine, totals;

WITH single_bond_molecules AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT molecule_id
  FROM bond
  WHERE bond_type = '-'
),
relevant_atoms AS (
  SELECT a.atom_id, a.element
  FROM atom AS a
  JOIN single_bond_molecules AS s
    ON s.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
)
SELECT ROUND(
  100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN element = 'Cl' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*),
  4
) AS chlorine_percentage
FROM relevant_atoms;

WITH bond_counts AS (
  SELECT
    m.molecule_id,
    m.label,
    COUNT(b.bond_id) AS total_bonds,
    SUM(CASE WHEN b.bond_type = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS single_bonds
  FROM molecule AS m
  LEFT JOIN bond AS b ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
  GROUP BY m.molecule_id, m.label
),
classified AS (
  SELECT
    CASE
      WHEN total_bonds > 0 AND total_bonds = single_bonds THEN 'every bond single'
      ELSE 'not every bond single'
    END AS saturation_group,
    label
  FROM bond_counts
)
SELECT
  saturation_group,
  SUM(CASE WHEN label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
    - SUM(CASE WHEN label = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
    AS carcinogenic_minus_non_carcinogenic
FROM classified
GROUP BY saturation_group
ORDER BY CASE saturation_group
  WHEN 'every bond single' THEN 1
  ELSE 2
END;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN a.element = 'Cl' THEN c.atom_id2 WHEN a2.element = 'Cl' THEN c.atom_id END) AS count_atoms_bonded_to_chlorine
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON a2.atom_id = c.atom_id2
WHERE a.element = 'Cl' OR a2.element = 'Cl';

WITH unique_elements AS (
    SELECT a.molecule_id, a.element
    FROM atom AS a
    WHERE a.molecule_id IS NOT NULL
      AND a.element IS NOT NULL
      AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM atom AS other
          WHERE other.element = a.element
            AND other.molecule_id <> a.molecule_id
      )
    GROUP BY a.molecule_id, a.element
),
qualifying_molecules AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id
    FROM molecule AS m
    JOIN unique_elements AS u
      ON u.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
    WHERE m.label = '+'
)
SELECT b.bond_id, b.molecule_id
FROM bond AS b
JOIN qualifying_molecules AS q
  ON q.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
ORDER BY b.bond_id, b.molecule_id;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
    WHEN a.element = 'cl' THEN c.atom_id2
    ELSE c.atom_id
END) AS atoms_bonded_to_chlorine
FROM connected AS c
JOIN atom AS a ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id
JOIN atom AS a2 ON a2.atom_id = c.atom_id2
WHERE (a.element = 'cl' AND a2.element <> 'cl')
   OR (a2.element = 'cl' AND a.element <> 'cl');

WITH atom_counts AS (
  SELECT
    molecule_id,
    COUNT(*) AS number_of_atoms,
    SUM(CASE WHEN UPPER(element) = 'C' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS carbon_atoms,
    SUM(CASE WHEN UPPER(element) = 'CL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS chlorine_atoms
  FROM atom
  GROUP BY molecule_id
),
bond_counts AS (
  SELECT
    b.molecule_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT b.bond_id) AS number_of_bonds,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
      WHEN UPPER(a1.element) = 'C' OR UPPER(a2.element) = 'C' THEN b.bond_id
    END) AS carbon_touching_bonds,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
      WHEN b.bond_type IN ('2', '3', 'DOUBLE', 'TRIPLE', '=', '#')
        THEN b.bond_id
    END) AS multiple_bonds
  FROM bond AS b
  LEFT JOIN connected AS c ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
  LEFT JOIN atom AS a1 ON a1.atom_id = c.atom_id
  LEFT JOIN atom AS a2 ON a2.atom_id = c.atom_id2
  GROUP BY b.molecule_id
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    m.molecule_id,
    m.label AS carcinogenicity_label,
    COALESCE(ac.number_of_atoms, 0) AS number_of_atoms,
    COALESCE(bc.number_of_bonds, 0) AS number_of_bonds,
    COALESCE(ac.carbon_atoms, 0) AS carbon_atoms,
    COALESCE(ac.chlorine_atoms, 0) AS chlorine_atoms,
    COALESCE(bc.carbon_touching_bonds, 0) AS carbon_touching_bonds,
    COALESCE(bc.multiple_bonds, 0) AS multiple_bonds
  FROM molecule AS m
  LEFT JOIN atom_counts AS ac ON ac.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
  LEFT JOIN bond_counts AS bc ON bc.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
  WHERE COALESCE(ac.carbon_atoms, 0) >= 1
)
SELECT
  ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
    ORDER BY carbon_touching_bonds DESC, number_of_atoms DESC, molecule_id ASC
  ) AS rank,
  molecule_id,
  carcinogenicity_label,
  number_of_atoms,
  number_of_bonds,
  carbon_atoms,
  chlorine_atoms,
  carbon_touching_bonds,
  multiple_bonds
FROM ranked
ORDER BY carbon_touching_bonds DESC, number_of_atoms DESC, molecule_id ASC;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS hydrogen_bond_count
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a1 ON a1.atom_id = c.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON a2.atom_id = c.atom_id2
WHERE a1.molecule_id = (
  SELECT molecule_id
  FROM atom
  WHERE element = 'Y'
  LIMIT 1
)
AND (a1.element = 'H' OR a2.element = 'H');

WITH eligible AS (
  SELECT molecule_id
  FROM molecule
  WHERE label = '-'
)
SELECT a2.element AS element, COUNT(*) AS bond_count
FROM bond b
JOIN eligible m ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
JOIN connected c ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
JOIN atom a1 ON a1.atom_id = c.atom_id AND a1.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
JOIN atom a2 ON a2.atom_id = c.atom_id2 AND a2.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type IN ('=', '#')
  AND (a1.element = 'c' OR a2.element = 'c')
  AND a2.element <> 'c'
GROUP BY a2.element
ORDER BY a2.element;

WITH target AS (
  SELECT molecule_id, label
  FROM molecule
  WHERE molecule_id = 'TR377'
),
bond_profile AS (
  SELECT
    b.bond_type AS bond_kind_symbol,
    COUNT(DISTINCT b.bond_id) AS bond_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
      WHEN a1.element <= a2.element THEN a1.element || '|' || a2.element
      ELSE a2.element || '|' || a1.element
    END) AS element_pair_count
  FROM target AS t
  JOIN bond AS b ON b.molecule_id = t.molecule_id
  JOIN connected AS c ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
  JOIN atom AS a1 ON a1.atom_id = c.atom_id
  JOIN atom AS a2 ON a2.atom_id = c.atom_id2
  WHERE b.bond_type IN ('-', '=', '1', '2')
  GROUP BY b.bond_type
)
SELECT
  t.label AS carcinogenicity_label,
  p.bond_kind_symbol,
  p.bond_count,
  p.element_pair_count
FROM target AS t
JOIN bond_profile AS p
ORDER BY p.bond_count DESC, p.bond_kind_symbol ASC;

SELECT
  a.element AS element_symbol,
  COUNT(DISTINCT a.molecule_id) AS molecule_count
FROM atom AS a
JOIN connected AS c ON c.atom_id = a.atom_id
JOIN bond AS b ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '#'
GROUP BY a.element
ORDER BY molecule_count DESC, element_symbol ASC;

SELECT a.element, COUNT(DISTINCT a.atom_id) AS bonded_atom_count
FROM atom AS a
JOIN molecule AS m ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = 'TR397'
  AND (
    EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM connected AS c WHERE c.atom_id = a.atom_id)
    OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM connected AS c WHERE c.atom_id2 = a.atom_id)
  )
GROUP BY a.element
ORDER BY a.element;
